about: Every priceable item read against its game text. status: applied (in the knowledge.js AUDIT block), kept (existing entry judged right), rejected (see LEARNING.md), manual (needs a new engine kind or a hand-written entry).

items.name: Lethal Blackjack
items.note: D20 spends your turn on a roll where 9 faces in 20 cost you HP, energy or put Vulnerable/Hexed/Cursed on yourself and only 10 in 20 help; averaged over the table it is about +1% damage and about -6% of max HP per roll at full health, so it is a trap on any build that is not already at 10% HP. It cannot be entered as a setup move, because setups are not charged for the turn.
synergies: last-stand at <=10% HP: rolls 1 and 2 are defanged (HP will not change below 10%, half of almost nothing) while 18 heals 25% and 20 fully heals with 6 energy - a 10% shot at a rescue
Corruption-form energy dumps (Blasphemy Notch): the 16/17/18/19/20 faces refund 1-6 energy, but 1/3 drain 2 or all of it
Deranged Fighter (Impaler): every self-debuff face adds +1% incoming healing per unique status - the only kit that gets anything back from the bad faces

items.name: Everbeating Drums
items.note: 20% per attack to splash a portion of the damage to all enemies; the portion is never stated, so it cannot be sized, and it does nothing at all in a single-target fight.
synergies: multi-enemy fights only: pairs with Snorb (also hits all opponents) on an AoE tank
Parasitic Leech: if splash counts as damage you dealt, the party heal rides on it (unstated)
Sanguine Fang: extra hits are extra 25% lifesteal rolls if the splash counts as a hit (unstated)

items.name: Rabbit Pelt
items.note: +5% defence per consecutive damaging move, capped at 30%, cleared the moment you use a non-damaging move; counted at 0.4 (about 12%) because it is zero on the opener, reaches 30% by the sixth straight attack, and resets on every buff turn of a nuke rotation. The other five Easter gears do not carry this passive in the data, only Rabbit Pelt does.
synergies: attack-every-turn kits: Berserker Carnage, Impaler Handaconda, Ranger - they reach the 30% cap by turn 6 and keep it
Yar'thul's Wrath and Coagulated Finger Nail: the same long-fight, never-stop-attacking rhythm
Anti-synergy with Shadow Form / Absolute Radiance / Meditate rotations (the standing Assassin nuke): every setup turn wipes the stacks, so it is worth 5-10% there at best
Egg Shelmet + Molten Carapace: three stacking defence sources for a pure tank

items.name: Egg Shelmet

effects.note: a shield worth 10% of max HP at the start of every fight

effects.uptimeSource: assumed: a 10%-of-max-HP shield goes on the first or second enemy hit, so the DR is up for most of a fight

items.note: Start every fight with a shield worth 10% of max HP, and once it breaks you keep a permanent 10% DR; the shield is counted at full, the DR at 0.8 because it is not up until the first hit or two land. The current entry prices the shield and drops the DR half entirely.
synergies: Molten Carapace (+30% defence below 40% HP) and Rabbit Pelt (ramping defence): stacking defence sources for an END tank
Snorb: being hit is what breaks the shield and what fires Snorb, so both are live from the first enemy attack
Divine Gift / Brittle Cure party-DR kits: another flat DR layer
Deranged Fighter / Bloody Berserker low-HP stances: the shield delays reaching the stance, a small anti-synergy

items.name: Chocolate Egg
items.note: Easter Snack heals one ally 7.5 HP and gives them 1% of their max HP regen for 2 turns, once per fight, for your whole turn; roughly 10-13 HP total, scaled by your outgoing healing, which is not worth a turn on any build. It is a LCK 1 stat stick.
synergies: Saint / Narthana's Leaf (+75% outgoing): 7.5 becomes about 13 HP - still nothing
Lasting Life / incoming-healing kits on the ally: the 1% regen ticks are proper heals and scale
Nothing solo: the text says target an ally, so a solo build cannot use it at all
items.partyValue: One ally, once per fight, gets 7.5 HP plus 1% of their max HP for 2 turns - about 10-13 HP after outgoing healing, for your turn; a party healer has any real heal that beats it.

items.name: Party Egg
items.note: Egg Throw is a 2-energy, 6-cooldown Physical hit of 5 + SPD/80 that puts 2 random statuses (ghostflame among them) on the target and gives you +7.5% Speed for 3 turns; the pool is unstated and 7.5% of a stat is not a flat number, so neither half can be scored. It costs a turn that a 5-damage attack does not repay.
synergies: Chaos Orb: each of the 2 statuses rolls its 33% for a third, so it turns any status-free kit into one that 'applies' for procStatusGain
Frozen Diadem / Tear Blood Crystal: a random chance of landing Cold or Bleed that cannot be counted
Cursed enchant (+30% vs Cursed, +20% vs Sundered): pays only if the random roll lands one of those
Dullahan Ghostflame / Shadowflamed +30% to Burning and Ghostflamed targets: the one named status feeds that line
Wicked Crown turns the egg Dark, so Shard of Blight applies - to 5 damage

items.name: Gleaming Carrot
items.note: Carrot Munch costs a turn and 2 energy, once per fight, for +1% crit per turn over 6 turns - zero on the opener, +6 at the peak, about +3.5 on average - which no attack turn is worth giving up for. The engine has no crit ramp kind and should not price it as a setup because setups are not charged for the turn.
synergies: A build parked 1-6 points below an overcrit tier boundary: +6 crit can tip a tier late in a fight, the only case where it does anything visible
Crystalized Star: more crits mean more Luck stacks, marginal on top of a 100%+ crit build
Anti-synergy with every nuke rotation: it spends the setup turn that Shadow Form or Absolute Radiance needed

items.name: Rabbit's Foot

effects.why: Cursed negates 75% of your healing (knowledge.js:2306); 2 rolls in 3 add a Cursed stack every turn, so at least two turns in three you carry one

items.note: The +5 Luck and +5 Speed are real, unconditional and not on the site (the gear block is LCK 2 only), but every turn two rolls in three put Cursed on you (healing cut 75%) and one in three puts a Hex on you (the next hit you take is doubled), so what you are actually buying is +5/+5 for roughly a third more damage taken and most of your healing gone. It needs an incoming-damage-multiplier kind to price the Hex honestly.
synergies: Any per-turn self-cleanse (the 5%-max-HP strip-all-statuses move at knowledge.js:380) turns it back into a free +5 Luck +5 Speed stick
Deranged Fighter (Impaler): Cursed + Hexed on you is +2% incoming healing - does not come close to offsetting the -75%
Reversing shard and other self-status feeders: check whether they pay on self Cursed/Hex the way they do on Ptera's Heart's self Poison; if so this is the cheapest self-status generator
Anti-synergy with every healer, Parasitic Leech and lifesteal kits: Cursed eats the heal; with Yar'thul's Wrath it is doubly bad because ally heals also cost Overheat stacks
Luck-tier crit builds at 110 Luck: +5 flat Luck is the one place the stat half is worth something on its own

items.name: Snorb
items.note: Every other turn, when you are hit, it puts 2 Cold on every opponent and deals 10% of your max HP to all of them - the Cold is priced as a status the kit now applies, the damage is a stated number the engine has no kind for (flat damage scaling with your own max HP, cannot land a killing blow), and the text itself says it feeds Parasitic Leech and Sanguine Fang.
synergies: Frozen Diadem: needsStatus cold is met by Snorb on ANY kit, so +5 crit vs Cold targets and +10 for 2 turns after each proc go live without an Ice move - the concrete pairing
Parasitic Leech: 2% of Snorb's damage heals every teammate, stated outright; Sanguine Fang rolls its 25% on the proc too
High-END races and tanks (Gynx END 8, Dullahan, Boreas, Inferion): the damage is 10% of max HP, so an END stack is a damage stat here
Egg Shelmet and Rabbit Pelt: the same 'get hit, keep standing' tank package; Snorb still fires while the shield holds
Multi-enemy fights: it hits all opponents, like Everbeating Drums, and against a multi-hit boss only the first hit counts

items.name: Elementary Resonance
items.note: The gear changes colour every turn and an attack of the matching element does +10% plus a per-element rider, so on a kit that attacks with one element it is a 1-in-9 shot each turn - about +1.1% damage on average, with the riders (Dark 25% lifesteal, Ice 3 Cold, Physical 2 Weakened + 2 Vulnerable, Arcane +1 energy, Nature 10% heal) landing at the same rate and not priced.
synergies: Wicked Crown: a crowned Physical kit is all Dark, so its only match is the Dark colour and the rider is 25% lifesteal on that hit
Chaos Orb: the Physical/Fire/Ice/Poison/Hex riders each apply statuses, and each rolls the orb's 33%
Frozen Diadem: the Ice rider's 3 Cold satisfies needsStatus on the turns it lands
Cursed enchant (+20% vs Sundered): the Hex rider's 3 Sundered
Blasphemy Notch dumps: the Arcane rider refunds 1 energy on a matched Magic hit
A genuinely multi-element kit (Corvolus casters, Mage scrolls) matches more often and is the only build that gets past the 1-in-9 floor

items.name: Frosty Topper
items.note: Summons a Snowman (75 base HP, ARC/6) for 2 energy every 10 turns. The Snowman then, on its own turns, pelts for 4 base (1 Blinded, chance of 1 Cold), heals the party 12 base with 5% DR for 4 turns, gives an ally an extra fully-AoE hit that puts 2 Cold on everything, or hands allies +10 Speed for 2 turns. Nothing here is priced: the engine has no summon kit.
synergies: Frozen Diadem (+5 crit against Cold targets - the Snowman keeps Cold up; the +10 'when you apply Cold' half is unclear when the summon applies it)
Snorb (second Cold source on being attacked)
Oppression mastery (+5% per unique status: Blinded, Cold on top of the kit's)
Imbuement Reliquary (the Snowman is a summon that would take your enchant - once the engine sees it as one)
Vastayan / summoner archetype (summon HP scales off ARC, so Call Snowman rides the ARC stack)
Divine Promise's Divine Gift can target the Snowman
Blizzard / Boreas ice kits (Ice-typed, Cold-applying)
items.partyValue: Almost everything it does reaches allies: a 12-base party heal with 5% DR for 4 of every 6 turns, +10 Speed to allies, and Jolly Spirit's extra AoE hit on an ally's attack - a genuine party damage buff. Solo it is a fragile 75-HP pet and a 2-ARC stat stick.

items.name: 7 Leafed Everthistle
items.note: x1.85 drop rate and gold at the end of the fight. A farming item - it does nothing inside a fight, so it is worn as a 3-Luck stat stick and scored as one.
synergies: Any fast-clear nuke build (the standing Assassin nuke) - the multiplier is per fight, so kills per hour are what it pays on
Crystalized Star / Crystal Sphere on a Luck kit - it at least contributes its 3 Luck to a crit tier
items.partyValue: Not stated to reach allies; the drop/gold multiplier is yours.

items.name: Shattered Clock Hand
items.note: Each Strike has a 30% chance to take 1 turn off every cooldown you have - an expected 0.3 turns per Strike, and nothing at all on a rotation that never Strikes. Real on a Strike-filler kit with long cooldowns, invisible to the engine today.
synergies: Pathfinder Mark (Strike scales END/75 - on an END tank the Strike turns this needs stop being dead turns)
Cursed Fists (+20% crit on strikes - same 'make Strike worth pressing' idea)
Long-cooldown setups it shortens: Absolute Radiance (cd 18), Heavenly Prayer (cd 22), Spirit Awakening (cd 18), Call Snowman (cd 10)
ARC 110 / STR 110 cooldown cuts (stack with it; the milestone cuts are already a cdCut)
Energy-starved builds that Strike as filler between dumps
items.partyValue: Your cooldowns only.

items.name: The Biggest Pebble
items.note: Pebble: 0 energy, 4-turn cooldown, +300% chance to escape the fight. A flee button - it spends a turn and contributes nothing to any combat goal. The slot is a 1-Speed stat stick.
items.partyValue: Escape is stated for you only.

items.name: Arbusta Tear
items.note: Arbusta's Fragrance: 0 energy, 7-turn cooldown, raises your aggro for 4 turns. A taunt - in a party it pulls the enemy's attacks onto you for 4 of every 7 turns, which is the tank's whole job; solo there is nobody to pull them off, so it is a 1-END stat stick that costs a turn.
synergies: Desert Escutcheon (more attacks on you = more blocks = charges)
Spore Root (only fires when you block a melee attack - the taunt is what makes that happen)
Snorb (procs whenever you are attacked)
Brittle Cure (taking a hit while it is up returns 1 energy a turn)
Molten Carapace / Steel Body / Holy Light / Egg Shelmet (the DR stack that makes being the target survivable)
Divine Promise on an ally (10% DR on the tank)
items.partyValue: For 4 of every 7 turns the enemy targets you instead of your allies - a party-only effect with no solo value, and one that should scale with partyScale the way partyDr does.

items.name: Parasitic Leech
items.note: Heals every teammate for 2% of the damage you deal - a proper heal, so your outgoing healing scales it and their incoming healing scales it; worth nothing solo.
synergies: Narthana's Leaf (1.75x outgoing healing -> 3.5% of your damage to every ally)
Holy Emissary / Saint outgoing-healing stack (same multiplier)
Snorb (its 10%-max-HP proc damage triggers the Leech - builder text says so)
Multi-hit and AoE nukes (Poison Fan 3.5x4, Leaf Thrust 2x3) - the heal is a share of total damage
ANTI: Lifesong enchant explicitly does not proc off Leech heals
ANTI: an ally wearing Yar'thul's Wrath loses an Overheat stack every time your Leech heals them (builder text: 'Parasitic Leech counts as a heal') - keep it off a party with a Yar'thul carrier
items.partyValue: Every ally gets 2% of your damage as a real heal; the engine already counts it per ally (partyScale - 1) and at zero solo, which is exactly what the text says.

items.name: Spore Root
items.note: When you block a melee attack: 2 Poison on the attacker, and a 30% chance of 2 Weakened. The poison damage itself is not priced; what it FEEDS is - the enemy Poison and Weakened it puts up are what Impure Crown, Oppression and the status-reading enchants see. Only ever fires on a build that blocks, so it stays gated to tank goals.
synergies: Impure Crown (+1 stack every time you apply Poison -> 3 per block)
Ptera's Heart (a second Poison source on the same target)
Oppression mastery (Poison + Weakened are two unique statuses on the target)
Arbusta Tear (taunt -> more melee attacks come at you -> more blocks)
Desert Escutcheon (the same block-every-turn play; both want a block tank)
Weakened lowers what the enemy deals to everyone - a tank sustain effect the engine does not price
items.partyValue: Statuses land on the enemy, not on allies; the Weakened protects the party second-hand but is not party-scaled.

items.name: Forest Charm
items.note: +25% to Nature attacks, everywhere - all of it on Nature moves and nothing on the rest. The +15% 'while in the forest' half is zone-gated and is not counted: the engine has no idea where you are fighting.
synergies: Arborivia's Leaf Thrust (Nature, 2x3 hits, +50 crit) - the pairing, once race actives are in the scored kit
Corvolus's Cast Amplify (+20% to six elements, Nature among them) stacks on the same move
Element Mastery (+15% incl. Nature) and the site's Elemental Master affinity (Fire/Magic/Nature/Dark)
Elementary Resonance on its Nature colour (heal 10% max HP on a Nature attack)
ANTI: Wicked Crown converts Physical to Dark, not Nature - it does nothing for this item
items.partyValue: Not stated to reach allies.

items.name: Elemental Infuser
items.note: From Sky to Soul: 3 energy, 10-turn cooldown, puts 3 Vulnerable on YOU for 3 turns and is meant to give Magic, Fire, Ice and Hex abilities +10/20/30% over those 3 turns. The game's own text says the buff is bugged and does not scale, so it is priced at nothing - and the self-Vulnerable still lands, so today it is a 3-ARC stat stick with a self-debuff button.
synergies: Madseer's Codex (the identical Magic/Fire/Ice/Hex gate - a kit that wears one wants the other, once this works)
Corvolus's Cast Amplify (Magic/Fire/Ice overlap; two ramps on one nuke)
Vulcan Knuckle (Fire) / Blizzard (Ice) / Hexblade Hex kits
ANTI: Boreas's Inner Frost (2-turn self-stun eats the 3-turn window)
ANTI: Stellian Core and other full-HP gates - 3 Vulnerable on yourself is the opposite of staying above 95%
ANTI: Bulk Up (stacking self-defence loss on top of Vulnerable)
items.partyValue: Self-buff only.

items.name: Crystalized Star
items.note: +10 Luck per successful crit for 2 effective turns, to 5 stacks - counted at 3 stacks (+30 Luck) over a fight and at ZERO on an opener, since the nuke lands before you have crit.
synergies: Poison Fan (3.5x4) and Leaf Thrust (2x3, +50 crit) - multi-hit at high crit builds stacks in one turn
Ages Pages / Crystal Sphere (+5 crit each - the way to reach 100% so every hit is a stack)
Stellian Core / Luck-scaling nukes (the extra Luck goes straight into the scaling and the crit tier)
Vastic Glaive's Luck branch (+80% crit for one attack)
ANTI: Shadow Form (an attack that stacks breaks Invisible, and the nuke it protects fires before any stack exists - which is exactly why the opener reads this at zero)
items.partyValue: Your Luck only.

items.name: Pathfinder Mark
items.note: Rewrites Strike's scaling from STR/75 to END/75 - a MOVE_OVERRIDES entry, not a passive number. Only moves a high-Endurance, low-Strength kit's 1-energy filler; on a damage build it is a 3 END stat stick.
synergies: Shattered Clock Hand (30% on Strike to cut cooldowns - makes an END kit's Strike spam worth pressing)
Coagulated Finger Nail (+1.5 END a turn feeds the new scaling)
Ramizcan Idol / Desert Escutcheon / Spore Root blocking kit (Strike is the attack between blocks)
Saint at 60 End (a healer's only attack becomes non-trivial)
Arbiter (N) - CONFLICT: its own Strike rewrite; unknown which applies
items.partyValue: no - it changes your own basic attack only

items.name: Gilded Pouch
items.note: No passive text exists for this item - it is a plain 3 Luck stat stick and the stat block is already scored. The name suggests a gold effect; that is unstated and would be out of combat anyway, so nothing is priced.
synergies: Crystal Sphere / Ages Pages / Crystalized Star - it is only ever the fourth Luck stick after those are taken
Assassin nuke line (pure Luck) as an overflow slot
items.partyValue: no - a stat block only

items.name: Crystal Sphere
items.note: +5% crit chance, unconditional - already in the site's own crit figure. Its 'removes crit fatigue' half does nothing: the mechanic no longer exists.
synergies: Ages Pages (+5 crit, also onSite) - the two flat crit sticks of the Assassin nuke
Crystalized Star (per-crit Luck ramp - more crit means more stacks)
Arborivia Overgrowth / Stellian Core full-HP crit (pushes the opener over a crit tier)
Luck-scaling kits at 110 Luck where the last 5 crit buys a tier
items.partyValue: no - your own crit chance

items.name: Dust Storm

extra.newKind: dodge (for GEAR_PASSIVES: add dodge:0 to gearPassiveTotals' out and read gp.dodge into ctx.dodge = min(95, ma.dodge + gp.dodge) - today ctx.dodge reads masteryAbilities only, so a gear dodge entry silently scores zero)

items.note: 10% avoidance: one attack in ten does no damage at all (debuffs still land). Avoidance, not reduction - it multiplies how long you last, exactly like Lightspeed - and it counts as a dodge for Swift Fighter, Verdant Archer and Lightspeed's stacking.
synergies: Lightspeed (Ranger capstone: +10% autododge per dodge, no cap - Dust Storm hands it free stacks even on a build with no Speed)
Verdant Archer (Ranger super) on-dodge proc
Swift Fighter (Slayer base) on-dodge proc
Speed dodge milestones (milestones.dodgePct stacks additively with it)
Egg Shelmet / Molten Carapace tank stacks (avoidance multiplies reduction)
items.partyValue: no - only attacks aimed at you

items.name: Golem Rune Core

extra.newKind: summon (a gear ACTIVE that adds a summon to any class: 75 base HP, ARC/6 scaling, own move list; should also flip buildDoes().summons, which today scans class/race/covenant/scroll moves only and never gearActives - so Stone Brand and Imbuement Reliquary stay flagged dead even with the golem out)

items.note: Gives any class a Sand Golem (75 base HP, ARC/6) with its own attacks, at the price of 2 energy and one of your turns once per fight. Its Sand Eruption stacks Weakened and Vulnerable on the enemy from turn 2-3; Core Rage rests the golem a turn for a permanent +40% damage. Not priced: no summon kind exists for gear.
synergies: Stone Brand (the golem gains Stone Skin - the only way a non-summoner gets both)
Imbuement Reliquary (the golem gets your enchant)
Spirit Awakening / Vastayan Spirit Caller (+summon HP; summon HP and damage scale on Arcane)
Spiked Steel Ball + Blight weapon + Crushing Strike Proficiency + Oppression (the golem's Weakened/Vulnerable feed every 'against weakened or vulnerable' gate)
Madseer's Codex or any Blind applier (Dust Burst stuns a Blinded target)
Stone Skin the turn before Core Rage (protects the cancellable rest turn)
items.partyValue: no - the golem is yours, though Sand Eruption's pseudo-AoE debuffs help everyone hitting those targets

items.name: Spiked Steel Ball
items.note: Every hit has a ~30-40% (dev claim, unverified) chance to deal +35% damage and put 1 Vulnerable and 1 Weakened on the target - counted at 35%, so +12.25% expected per hit, on any attack of any element. The site applies this in its own damage line but not through gearPctBonuses, so the engine must price it itself.
synergies: Blight weapon (+20% vs Weakened/Vulnerable - SSB supplies the statuses on kits that have none)
Crushing Strike Proficiency (+20% vs vulnerable or weakened)
Oppression (+5% per unique status - two more)
Golem Rune Core's Sand Eruption (stacks the same two statuses)
Leaf Thrust 2x3 / Dust Burst 6x3 (six rolls a turn - near-certain proc, and the +35% lands on the hits that proc)
Primordial weapon / Wicked Crown (multiplicative with a flat kit, no element gate to fight)
items.partyValue: no - the +35% is your hit; the statuses stay on the enemy for anyone, but that is not priced

items.name: Stone Brand

extra.newKind: summonDr (60% DR on your summons for 3 turns, cd 6 -> uptime 0.5, cost 2 of the summon's energy; feeds the summon archetype's survival, not your own DR)

items.note: Your summons learn Stone Skin: 60% damage reduction against most attacks for 3 turns every 6 (2 energy, the summon's turn). Worth nothing without a summon; not priced because the engine has no summon-DR kind.
synergies: Golem Rune Core (the pairing that lets any class use it; Stone Skin the turn before Core Rage protects the cancellable rest turn and stacks with its +15% def)
Necromancer skeletons / Darkwraith darkbeasts (summons that die to AoE last twice as long)
Vastayan Spirit Caller (+20% summon HP) and Spirit Awakening
Imbuement Reliquary (same summons-only condition, same builds)
items.partyValue: no - it protects your own summons, not allies

items.name: Ramizcan Idol
items.note: +15% damage for one turn after you block or parry. Blocking spends the turn, so this is a cost on a damage kit and pays only where you block anyway or where a parry is itself the hit (Blade Dancer). Counted at half uptime, one stack, and zero on an opener.
synergies: Blade Dancer Parry Counter with Parry Master (the parry is the attack, so the +15% rides the counter and the following turn for free)
Desert Escutcheon (charges on block) and Spore Root (2 Weakened on a blocked melee hit) - the blocking kit
Pathfinder Mark (an END Strike as the follow-up hit)
Calvariae Brittle Cure (a build that expects to be hit)
items.partyValue: no - your own next hit

items.name: Band of Crushing Force

effects.gate: an enemy blocked a hit of yours - lasts to the end of your next turn

items.note: +25% against a blocking enemy, and +10% until the end of your next turn once an enemy blocks a hit of yours - both fire on the same event, so they share one assumed block rate. The 15% desert damage reduction printed in game does not work.
synergies: Multi-hit moves (Leaf Thrust, Dust Burst) - more hits, more chances a block triggers the +10 for next turn
Fights against blocking enemies specifically - no kit choice raises it
STR 2 / END 1 block sits naturally on a Strength kit
items.partyValue: no - your own hits

items.name: Grain Of Balance
items.note: BUGGED: it should move 25% of your highest stat onto the other four, but currently seems to grant negative stat points instead - a downside, not a neutral. Avoid until fixed; Gilded Pouch is the same 3 Luck without the bug, and even fixed it would only suit an all-round spread.
synergies: none - it is dominated by Gilded Pouch for the stat block and by Crystal Sphere for any Luck build
if fixed: hybrid/allround kits only; anti-synergy with every single-stat build (Assassin Luck nuke, STR Berserker)
items.partyValue: no - your own stats

items.name: Madseer's Codex

extra.cost: increases QTE difficulty (size unstated) - a real cost for block/dodge QTE play

items.note: On Magic, Fire, Ice and Hex attacks: an unstated chance to apply one random status from Poisoned, Cursed, Blinded, Crippled, Weakened, Vulnerable. Not priced: the chance is never given. It also makes your QTEs HARDER, which is a cost - more failed blocks and dodges.
synergies: Oppression (+5% per unique status on target) - the random pool raises the unique count on a caster
Chaos Orb (33% extra status per application) chains off each proc
Cursed Brand's Curse Consumption eats the statuses for summon damage on a caster-summoner
Element Mastery casters (Magic/Fire/Ice/Hex kit) are the only wearers it fires for
ANTI: Desert Escutcheon and Spore Root - harder block QTE means more failed blocks and charge resets
ANTI: Wicked Crown kits - converted moves are Dark, not in the Codex's element list
items.partyValue: Weakened and Vulnerable land on a shared target, so when it does fire every attacker in the party benefits; the chance is still unstated, so this is a note in a party too.

items.name: Impure Crown
items.note: +1 Poison stack on every Poison you apply (same instance, not a new one). The engine prices no DoT output, so the stack is listed, not scored; worth exactly nothing on a kit that applies no Poison.
synergies: Ptera's Heart - 3 Poison on every enemy at fight start plus 1 a turn; each application becomes one stack heavier
Poisoner (poison per crit) with multi-hit crits such as Leaf Thrust 2x3
Poison Fan (Assassin) and Spore Root (2 Poison on a blocked melee hit becomes 3)
Wicked Crown + Ptera's Heart + Impure Crown - immune to the self-poison, enemy still takes the heavier stacks
ANTI: Cursed Brand's Curse Consumption removes the Poison you just stacked
ANTI: Boss profiles immune to Poison (BOSS immuneStatuses) make it a 4-Arcane stat stick
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches allies; the extra stack is your own Poison ticking on the target.

items.name: The Last Straw
items.note: 1 stack of Invisibility every five turns - about one attack in five made while invisible, for free and with no turn spent. Not priced: the engine only knows invisibility through Shadow Master's fixed 0.5 uptime and Stealth Strike's override, and neither reads a gear-granted uptime.
synergies: Shadow Master (+30% while invisible) on a class WITHOUT Shadow Form - the only way to get the bonus on a non-Assassin
Stealth Strike (x2 damage if invisible) - a free doubled hit every five turns
Assassin: stacks with Shadow Form (cd 7) to raise invisible-attack share from ~14% to ~34%
Absolute Radiance rotation: park the free stack on the ramped nuke turn
ANTI: multi-hit stacking attacks (Leaf Thrust) break the stack on the first hit, the same trade LEARNING gap 2 names for Shadow Form
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches allies; whether enemies retarget teammates while you are invisible is unstated.

items.name: Imbued Chains
items.note: Currently bugged - the passive does nothing in game. Worn only for its Speed 4.
synergies: None: it is a Speed 4 stat stick until the bug is fixed; The Last Straw carries the same Speed 4 with a working passive
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches anyone; the passive does not work.

items.name: Delicate Purse
items.note: A random amount of gold at the end of an encounter, reduced by damage taken during it. Economy, not combat - never scored. Worn for the Luck 3.
synergies: Avoidance builds (Lightspeed autododge, Dust Storm phase) take less damage and so keep more of the gold
Farming loops rather than boss fights
items.partyValue: Gold is per player; a tank or healer keeping damage off you indirectly raises your payout, but nothing in combat reaches allies.

items.name: Desert Escutcheon
items.note: Every successful block adds a Charge; at 3 the next blocked hit is ignored entirely, so under perfect blocking one blocked hit in four does nothing (25% avoidance, not reduction). Charges reset if you fail a block OR dodge, so it fights any dodge build. Counted at an assumed half uptime for imperfect blocking, and only once the engine has a dodge lane for gear.
synergies: Tank capstones (Holy Shield, Strategist dr) and Egg Shelmet - the ignored hit stacks multiplicatively with reduction
Spore Root - the other block-gated item; both want a build that guards every turn
Player-timed: bank 3 charges and eat a boss's telegraphed big hit - worth more than the flat average
ANTI: Lightspeed autododge and Dust Storm - every dodge wipes the charges
ANTI: Madseer's Codex - harder block QTE means more failed blocks and resets
items.partyValue: Self only; the ignored hit is the one you were blocking.

items.name: Cursed Brand
items.note: Active, 2 energy, 5 turn cooldown: spend 10% of your summon's HP to consume the target's statuses (not Heavy Stun) for +5% summon damage per status consumed. Duration unstated, so it cannot be scored; it costs the summon health, costs you the turn, and strips the DoTs and debuffs your own kit put on the target.
synergies: Necromancer (Call Skeleton, Raise Dead) and Darkwraith - the only kits with a summon to buff
Vastayan Spirit Caller (+20% summon HP, +50% Skeletons) - the 10% HP tithe bites less
Imbuement Reliquary - the other summon-gated Deeproot-adjacent item; same wearer
Madseer's Codex / Chaos Orb on a caster-summoner - a steady supply of statuses to consume
ANTI: Impure Crown, Ptera's Heart, Poisoner - it eats the Poison you are stacking
ANTI: Oppression and Shattering - both read statuses on the target that this removes
items.partyValue: The buff is on your own summon; nothing reaches allies, and consuming the target's statuses removes debuffs your allies may have been exploiting.

items.name: Narthana's Leaf

extra.cost: 25% max HP, encoded by the site as -25 Endurance

items.note: Sacrifice 25% of max HP for 1.75x outgoing healing (regen excluded). Both halves - the +75% outgoing and the -25 Endurance - are in the site's own stat maths, so the engine adds nothing here.
synergies: Saint: Holy Emissary +35% outgoing stacks with it - and the -25 END pushes the Endurance you need for Narthana's Sigil (60, ~102 with Astra) higher
Lifesong enchant (+20% out / +20% in) and One For All (+50% out, -30% dmg)
Parasitic Leech - a proper heal scaled by outgoing healing, so the Leaf multiplies it too
Breath of Fungyir and every heal move in healMovesFor
ANTI: Utor's healPctPerTurn / any regen - text says regen is unaffected
ANTI: Lasting Life, Frugality - incoming-side, untouched
items.partyValue: The 1.75x multiplies every heal you put on an ally, so almost all of its value is in a party; solo it is a quarter of your health spent to buff only your own self-heals.

items.name: Wicked Crown
items.note: Turns all your Physical moves into Dark. That part is priced through the converted type: Dark-gated bonuses reach them (Shard of Blight +25%, Corvolus's Cast Amplify, Element Mastery) and Physical-gated ones stop (STR 110's Physical cooldown cut). The Poison immunity and -15% incoming DoT are not priced.
synergies: Shard of Blight (+25% to Dark) - the pairing the engine already names
Corvolus Cast Amplify (Dark-gated setup buff) on a physical melee kit
Element Mastery (+15% includes dark) now pays on a converted melee kit
ARC 110 milestone - its non-Physical cooldown cut now reaches the converted moves
Ptera's Heart - immune to the self-poison half, the enemy still takes 3+1 a turn (but Reversing/Deranged Fighter lose that self-status feed)
ANTI: STR 110 Physical cooldown cut and any Physical-only bonus stop applying
ANTI: single-element Dark kit into a boss that adapts (BOSS_PENALTIES.oneElement)
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches allies; the conversion, immunity and DoT reduction are all on your own sheet.

items.name: Sanguine Fang
items.note: 25% chance on hit to heal 10% of the attack's damage - 2.5% lifesteal on average, on every attack.
synergies: Snorb - its 10% max-HP proc against all enemies can roll the Fang, free sustain off a defensive item
Multi-hit moves (Leaf Thrust 2x3) roll the 25% per hit - same expected 2.5%, far less variance
Nuke builds - lifesteal scales with sustainedHit, so a bigger hit heals more in absolute terms
Compare Shadow Gauntlets: 5% flat is strictly more lifesteal; the Fang's STR 1 / LCK 2 stat block is the trade
items.partyValue: Self only; the heal lands on you.
items.niche: none - a small sustain rider on any attacker

items.name: Coagulated Finger Nail
items.note: +1.5 to every stat at the start of each turn, to 10 turns; counted at 5 stacks (+7.5 each) over a fight and at ZERO on an opener - a stack you have not built yet is not damage you have. In game the Endurance half is DR, not HP; counted as Endurance, as the site does.
synergies: Long-fight / attrition kits (Saint healer, Impaler self-sustain): the full +15 to every stat at turn 10
Three-turn openers (Assassin Shadow Form -> Absolute Radiance -> Poison Fan) land on 3 stacks (+4.5), not the 7.5 assumed - the honest opener figure is closer to zero than to the sustained one
Permuth on the build's main stat scales the ramped total too
Anti: one-turn nukes and short mob fights get nothing
items.partyValue: Self only.

items.name: Shard of Blight
items.note: +25% to Dark attacks only, at full value on matching moves; Wicked Crown turns Physical moves into Dark ones, which is the pairing. The 15% defence is gated on standing in Deeproot Canopy and is not counted.
synergies: Wicked Crown (Physical -> Dark, builder.js:4487) on a physical kit: Assassin Stealth Strike / Impaler become Dark and collect the 25%
Corvolus Cast Amplify (+20% incl. dark) stacks on the same converted moves
Native Dark kits (Dark Smite Proficiency, Darksigil artifact)
Anti: Thorian resists Dark at 0.70 (BOSS_DATA) - a crowned kit loses more to the resist than the shard gives back in that fight
items.partyValue: Self only.

items.name: Traveler's Lamp
items.note: Starts every fight with +1 energy (not scoreable yet: needs an opening-energy kind) and 3 Vulnerable on every enemy, which is the site's flat x1.20 on the opening turns and feeds every Vulnerable-gated bonus. Light outside battle does nothing in combat.
synergies: Blight weapon series (+20% vs Weakened/Vulnerable) and Crushing Strike Proficiency: their gates are up from turn 1
Blasphemy Notch dumps (Ice Shards, The Right Angle) and Carnage: the extra opening energy is a turn saved or +20% on the pool dump
Any multi-turn opener: the x1.20 covers exactly the three turns a Shadow Form -> Radiance -> nuke sequence takes
Party: every ally hits the same Vulnerable enemies - the debuff is team-wide by construction
items.partyValue: 3 Vulnerable on all enemies is a team-wide x1.20 for the opening turns, so in a party its damage half is worth about the team size times its solo value.

items.name: Expedite Anklet

extra.cost: a setup turn, which the setup scorer does not charge

items.note: Gear ACTIVE Godspeed (0 energy, 12 cooldown): a flat +30 Speed for an unstated duration, 1 energy per dodge while it is up, and it removes block/dodge bar fatigue. Not counted yet - the setup scorer has no flat-stat column.
synergies: Speed-scaling moves: Blade Dancer Flowing Dance (SPD/50 with Proficiency), Stinger (ARC/70 + SPD/100), Ranger Flourish (+25/+48) and Stultus Focus Step (+LVL x 2) stack flat Speed with it
Ranger Lightspeed (autododge ramps to total avoidance): 1 energy per dodge turns a dodge tank into an energy engine
Vainglorious Locket / initiative kits: more Speed on top of act-first
Anti: costs a turn of the opener for a stat that most nukes scale on only lightly
items.partyValue: Self only.

items.name: Phantom Ooze
items.note: Gear ACTIVE Gluttony (0 energy, 14 cooldown) eats up to 10 negative stacks on you and applies 1 Cursemaw per stack; Cursemaw is -5% DR per stack while it lasts. Not counted: the text does not say whether Cursemaw lands on you (a cost) or the enemy (a shred), and the cleanse has no number.
synergies: Self-status kits feed it: Ptera's Heart (3 Poison on you + 1 a turn), Impaler self-bleed, From Sky to Soul (3 self-Vulnerable), D20 rolls
Anti: Deranged Fighter / Lasting Life / Reversing WANT those self statuses - Gluttony eats the stacks they count
If Cursemaw is an enemy debuff: pairs with any nuke into a blocking or high-DR boss and with a party (everyone hits the shredded target)
items.partyValue: Unknown - if Cursemaw lands on the enemy, every ally benefits from the DR shred.

items.name: Imperial Headband
items.note: Gear ACTIVE Self Destruct (2 energy, no cooldown): once your summons are under 90% HP, detonate them for AoE damage equal to twice their total HP, with an unstated chance of 2 Stun and 2 Weakened. Not counted: the engine has no summon HP to double, and it costs the summons.
synergies: Vastayan (+20% summon HP, Skeletons +50%) and Call Skeleton Proficiency (+50% HP on the next skeleton): summon HP is the damage stat here
Blazing Brand: enemies hitting your summons is what drops them under 90% and arms the trigger, and adds 3 Burn on the way
Summon kits (Call Skeleton, Call Darkbeast, Metrom's Vessel's 250-HP Sheea = a 500 AoE hit)
Anti: any kit whose damage is the summons themselves - detonating them ends that
items.partyValue: Self only (the AoE hits enemies, not allies).

items.name: Magma Charm
items.note: 10% resistance to Fire attacks and 15% faster movement outside combat. Not counted: the engine has no way to know what element the enemy hits you with, and movement speed is not combat.
synergies: Fire fights: Yar'Thul, The Blazing Dragon and Volcano content - the only place the 10% is up
Volcano set with Vulcan Knuckle and Molten Carapace on a survival kit
Aspect of Maladaptation is the existing precedent for element-conditional DR (priced at half); this one is narrower and should not borrow that uptime
Otherwise an END 1 / SPD 2 stat stick
items.partyValue: Self only.

items.name: Vulcan Knuckle
items.note: +15% to Fire moves - all of it, on Fire moves, and nothing on the rest. It also turns Strike into a Fire move (so Strike takes the 15%, Cast Amplify and the Dragon series, and loses Fractured's Physical bonus); the 15% Volcano defence is location-gated and not counted.
synergies: Fire kits: Monk (Or) and Lionheart (N) carry three Fire moves each, Elementalist (Or) one; races Inferion (Ob), Dullahan (1%), Veneri; scrolls Fireball / Immolation / Absolute Radiance
Corvolus Cast Amplify (+20%, fire is in its list) and Blaze Proficiency stack additively on the same moves
Dragon weapon series (+15% vs Burning) with Blazing Brand's Burn: a Fire Strike into a burning target
Dragon Memoir: a Strike-spam kit gets Fire Strike + Bleed/Fractured from the same button
Anti: Yar'Thul resists Fire at 0.50 - converting Strike to Fire halves it in that fight; Thorian takes 1.10 from Fire
items.partyValue: Self only.

items.name: Dragon Memoir
items.note: Your first Strike or Magic Missile puts 2 Bleed on the target, the next three put 2 Fractured (the site's x1.35 on Physical/Magic hits), then 2 Bleed per basic for the rest of the fight. Counted as a Bleed and Fractured applier for the gates it opens; the x1.35 window is not priced because it costs Strike turns.
synergies: Tear Blood Crystal (+5 crit / +5 DR on applying Bleed) - this item satisfies its GEAR_NEEDS gate
Vital Strike (+20% vs bleeding), Siphoning (5% lifesteal vs bleeding), Rending Barrage Proficiency (+2.5% per Bleed stack)
Physical / Magic nukes: Strike on turn 2 puts Fractured up for a x1.35 nuke on turn 3 - a real combo for a kit with a spare turn
Best flat STR gear in the batch (STR 4) for any Strength kit regardless
Anti: Impaler already bleeds everything, so the Bleed half is redundant there; Wicked Crown / Vulcan Knuckle kits lose the Fractured payoff
items.partyValue: Bleed and Fractured on the enemy are team-wide - allies' bleed-gated passives and Physical/Magic hits benefit too.

items.name: Blazing Brand
items.note: When enemies attack your summons they take unstated small damage and 3 Burn. Counted as a Burn applier for the gates it opens, only on a kit that summons; the reflect damage has no number and is not priced.
synergies: Dragon weapon series (+15% vs Burning, currently a guessed 0.45 uptime) and Lightning Crash / Blazing Barrage Proficiency (+20% vs burning)
Torching Soul (heals 3% of max HP per Burn)
Imperial Headband: the same enemy hits that trigger the Burn drop the summons under 90% HP and arm Self Destruct
Vastayan and Call Skeleton / Call Darkbeast kits - anything that puts a body between you and the enemy
Anti: worthless on a kit with no summons, however good ARC 3 looks on a Saint
items.partyValue: Burn on the enemy is team-wide - every ally's burn-gated bonus (Dragon weapons) reads it.

items.name: Molten Carapace
items.note: +30% defence below 40% HP - 25% uptime on a neutral build, 80% on a class built to fight hurt (Berserker, Impaler, Brawler, Darkwraith) and 5% on one that wants to stay full.
synergies: Berserker (Ch) - Bloodlust stacks below 50% HP, so the 40% gate is where the build already lives
Impaler (Ch) - Bloody Berserker wants you near 1 HP; this is the DR that lets you stay there
Brawler (N) - Bruiser is also a below-50% passive; same stance
Vow of Ruin - absorbing 25% of an ally's damage walks you under 40% on purpose
ANTI: Stellian Core (above 95%) and any party healer topping you up switch it off
ANTI: Egg Shelmet's opening shield delays the moment it turns on
items.partyValue: Self only; if anything a party healer keeping you above 40% is what turns it off.

items.name: Gelat Band
items.note: No combat effect: it lets you speak with the King Slime statue. Worn for ARC 2 and nothing else.
synergies: None - it is a 2-Arcane stat stick, and any Arcane 4 gear (Blazing Perforator, Frostburned Rune) beats it on the slot for the same stat
Only reason to wear it is the King Slime statue dialogue, which is out of combat
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches allies.

items.name: Tear Blood Crystal
items.note: +5% crit and +5% defence for 5 turns each time you apply Bleed - inert on a kit that never bleeds (GEAR_NEEDS), and zero on the very hit that applies it.
synergies: Impaler (Ch) - a bleed kit that reapplies every few turns keeps the 5-turn buff near-permanent (golden impaler-handa wears it)
Sanguine Fang / Shadow Gauntlets - the extra crit feeds any crit-scaled lifesteal on the same bleed kit
DeathBeak Dagger - a bleed-applying crit pays the 0.25 dagger coefficient and the +5 crit makes more of them
Shattering / Reversing style status readers - Bleed on the enemy is what they read too
ANTI: Ptera's Heart does not help - Poison is not Bleed, the gate is Bleed specifically
items.partyValue: Self only: the crit and defence buff is on you, not the party.

items.name: Ptera's Heart
items.note: 3 Poison on you and on every enemy at the start of the fight and 1 more each turn; Poison deals damage equal to its stacks and is LETHAL, so the ~3 a turn it costs you is trivial at full HP and a real killer on a 1-HP Impaler.
synergies: Impure Crown - gear counts as a poison source, so it wakes Impure Crown on a kit with no Poison of its own
Reversing / Deranged Fighter / Lasting Life - read the Poison on YOU
Shattering / Poisoner / Poison Fan Proficiency ('if the target is already poisoned') - read the Poison on the enemy from turn 1, before your first attack lands
Open Hand / Ophimar - decay your own statuses by 2, which cancels the 1-a-turn self-poison entirely and leaves only the enemy half
HAZARD: Impaler (Ch) at 1 HP for Bloody Berserker - a 3-damage lethal poison tick ends the fight; pair with Open Hand or a self-heal
ANTI: Cursed on you (healing to 0) plus this poison is a slow death with no counter
items.partyValue: The enemy-side Poison is on every enemy on the field, so every ally's poison-reading effects (Shattering, Poisoner, an ally's Impure Crown) get a poisoned target from turn 1 without spending a move.

items.name: DeathBeak Dagger
items.note: Every crit throws a dagger for BaseDMG x CritDMG x 0.15 (0.25 if the move applies a status), once per hit on multihits, cannot crit, ignores your buffs but takes your enchant and the enemy's statuses. Not counted until a critProc kind exists.
synergies: Assassin nuke (Arborivia, 100%+ crit) - fires on every hit; on Poison Fan the move applies Poison so the coefficient is 0.25
Arborivia Leaf Thrust (2x3 hits, +50 crit) - up to six daggers in one turn, which nothing else in the engine models
Ice Shards (3.5x4, applies Cold and Weakened) - four daggers at 0.25 per cast
Crystalized Star / Stellian Core / Frozen Diadem - anything that raises crit chance raises how often it fires
Enchant damage - explicitly multiplies the dagger, so an enchant-heavy build gets more of it
Vulnerable / Hexed on the enemy multiply it too
ANTI: buff-stacked nukes (Absolute Radiance, Blasphemy, Frost Stacks) shrink its share, because the dagger is computed from unbuffed base damage
items.partyValue: Self only - the dagger hits the enemy you crit.

items.name: Blazing Perforator
items.note: Half of all burn damage becomes healing instead, Ghostflame excluded - but the text never says whose burn (the Burn you take, or the Burn you deal), so it is reported, not priced. The site's Burn tick is 0.7% max HP +0.2% per stack, so 'half' is at most 0.35% + 0.1%/stack a turn.
synergies: If it is burn you DEAL: Blaze Proficiency (guaranteed 6-turn Burn), Fireball (3 Burning), Inferno weapon (25% chance 3 Burning), Elementary Resonance on Fire (5 Burn), Surprise Package on Fire (10 Burning), Frostburned Rune on an Ice kit (30% Burn per Ice move) - these are what would feed it
If it is burn you TAKE: Yar'thul (the dragon it drops from) and Volcano mobs that burn you; Torching Soul ('heal 3% when inflicted with Burn') is the same idea in a scroll and would stack with it
Dullahan / Ghostflame kits get nothing - explicitly excluded
Frostburned Rune - the natural pairing in the drop table: Ice moves that apply Burn plus this
ANTI: Blazing Barrage / Burning Conversion consume Burn - a detonated stack is not a tick to convert
items.partyValue: Unknown until the direction is known; if it converts burn you deal, any heal it produces is yours, not the party's.

items.name: Yar'thul's Wrath
items.note: +8% damage and +7.5% speed per Overheat stack, one stack every 5 turns (cap 10, Parasitic Leech and any ally heal strip one) - nothing on an opener, about +16% by turn 10. Not counted until the engine has a damage ramp.
synergies: Long boss fights and the Cult of Thanasius-style sustained kits - the only place it reaches 3+ stacks
Vainglorious Locket / act-first builds - the +7.5% speed per stack is a second speed source, unpriced today
Self-heals only: Shadow Gauntlets, Sanguine Fang, healPctPerTurn effects - healing yourself does not strip a stack
ANTI: Parasitic Leech - explicitly named as a heal that strips a stack, so never both on one build in a party
ANTI: any party healer (Saint, Way of Life) - each of their heals costs you a stack
ANTI: the Assassin turn-3 nuke (Shadow Form > Radiance > Poison Fan) - it is worth exactly zero there and the reference build wears it for the STR 2 SPD 2 block
items.partyValue: Self only, and worse in a party: every ally heal removes a stack (GEAR_NEEDS healedBy caution already says so).

items.name: Frostburned Rune
items.note: Fire moves have a 30% chance to apply Cold and Ice moves a 30% chance to apply Burn - a status source for a Fire or Ice kit only; the statuses themselves do no priced damage, they feed what reads them.
synergies: Frozen Diadem on a FIRE kit - Fire moves now apply Cold, so the +5 vs Cold and +10 on applying Cold wake up; at 30% a hit the +10's 2-turn window is up roughly half the time
Frosted enchant / Icerind weapon (+20% vs Cold) / Snorb-style Cold readers on a Fire kit
Blazing Perforator, Dragon weapon (+15% vs Burning), Lightning Crash / Blaze Proficiency-style burn readers on an ICE kit - Boreas's Ice moves get a Burn to read
Boreas (1%) - Frost Stacks force an all-Ice rotation, and this gives that rotation Burn without breaking the stack
DeathBeak Dagger - a move that applies a status pays the 0.25 coefficient, but only if the site's moveAppliesStatusEffect reads the move text, which this passive does not change
ANTI: Physical, Holy, Dark, Poison, Nature kits - nothing to convert; ARC 4 stat stick
items.partyValue: Self only; the Cold/Burn it applies sits on the enemy where allies' readers can use it, but it is your Fire/Ice hits that apply it.

items.name: Vow of Ruin

extra.cost: 1 energy and your action to cast, plus 25% of every hit your linked ally takes for 3 turns lands on you

items.note: Party-only active (1 energy, cd 3): link an ally for 3 turns, take 25% of the damage dealt to them, then explode for an unstated amount that scales with what you absorbed. Costs your turn and your HP; solo it does nothing.
synergies: Molten Carapace / Berserker Bloodlust / Impaler Bloody Berserker - the absorbed damage walks you into the low-HP stance those want
Egg Shelmet - the opening shield eats the first absorbed hits
Parasitic Leech / Sanguine Fang / any lifesteal - refills what the link costs you
A hit-magnet ally: a summoner, a Taunt tank, or the party's healer being focused - the more they take, the bigger the explosion
ANTI: linking an Assassin in Shadow Form - immune to damage, so the link absorbs nothing and explodes for nothing
ANTI: Yar'thul's Wrath is unaffected (taking damage is not being healed), but a healer patching the link damage strips its stacks
items.partyValue: Only pays in a party: it is a bodyguard-and-detonate tool - 25% of a squishy ally's incoming damage moved onto an END 4 wearer, then paid back as damage - and the more allies focus-fire the same target the more the explosion is worth.

items.name: Frozen Diadem
items.note: +5 crit while the target has Cold and a non-stacking +10 for 2 turns each time you apply it - both halves need Cold, so it is a 4-Luck stick on any kit that never applies it, and roughly +8 crit sustained on one that does. Zero on an opener: the applying hit does not get it.
synergies: Boreas (1%) - Cold Application (~25% per attack, 2 Cold) plus an all-Ice rotation keeps both halves up (RACE_TECH already names this)
Snorb - 2 Cold on every enemy every other turn when you are hit; the +5 half is up almost always and Snorb is the only Cold source the engine detects today
Ice Shards (3.5x4, applies 3 Cold) / Permafrost Curse (2 Cold) - the applying moves; note the 8-10 turn cooldowns, which is why 0.55 not 1
Frostburned Rune - extends it to FIRE kits (Fire moves apply Cold at 30%)
Frosted enchant / Icerind weapon (+20% vs Cold) - the same Cold pays three times
Crystalized Star / DeathBeak Dagger / Sanguine Fang - crit-fed effects that this crit feeds
ANTI: Physical, Holy, Dark, Poison kits with no Cold source - inert, 4 Luck only
items.partyValue: Self only; an ally's Cold on the target does satisfy the +5 half ('enemies with the Cold status'), which is the one thing a party changes.

items.name: Imbuement Reliquary
items.note: Summons get the full effects of your enchant. Worth whatever the enchant is worth, on the summons only - no number of its own, and nothing at all on a kit that summons nothing (GEAR_NEEDS already refuses it there).
synergies: Necromancer (Ch) / Darkwraith (Ch) / Vastayan (9%) summon kits - the only builds where it fires at all
a flat-figure enchant: Heavy Hand (+dmg on 2+ cost skills), Devastating (crit dmg), Fortunate (crit), Inferno (Burn), Cursed (+30% vs Cursed) - the summons inherit whichever one is worn

The Smallest Boulder is a summon, so Vital (+HP%) might reach the Boulder through this - UNVERIFIED: the Boulder text says Vastayan's summon-HP passive does not, so summon-HP buffs may not apply to it

items.name: Divine Promise
items.note: An ally or summon gets 1 Energy and 10% DR for 5 turns on a 3-turn cooldown - the whole reason to wear it, and worth nothing solo unless you have a summon to target.
synergies: The Smallest Boulder: Divine Gift can target a summon, and the Boulder is one - 10% DR on the damage sponge in a solo fight
Necromancer skeletons / Darkbeasts as solo targets, same reason
party energy: the +1 Energy to an ally is a team multiplier (LEARNING open gap 3) - feeds a teammate's Carnage or Blasphemy dump
Saint / Jade support kits that already spend turns on allies
items.partyValue: Every 3 turns one ally gets +1 Energy and 10% DR for 5 turns (uptime 5/3 = permanent on one target); the energy half is a team damage multiplier the engine does not yet count.

items.name: Focused Mind
items.note: +20% damage and 15% MORE damage taken for the turn after a Meditate. Both halves counted at the same 0.3 uptime; the Meditate turn itself is a turn you do not attack, which the engine does not charge.
synergies: Combat Focus soul node (Path of Destruction: +2%/rank, 5 ranks, 2 turns after meditating) - the same trigger, up to +30% together on the post-Meditate hit
Calm Mind soul node (Meditate damage vulnerability -5%/rank) - offsets the 15% extra damage taken
Heresy: the wing-swap Meditate the rotation already pays for (knowledge.js ~2961) makes the +20% free on the Light Force hit that follows
Tyranny: Meditate harvests Mandate into your pool - again a turn the form already spends
energy-hoarding dumps (Carnage, a Blasphemy 3+ energy Notch spender): a build that Meditates for energy anyway gets +20% on the dump for nothing
Spreading Grace (covenant): Meditating hands an ally +1 energy, and Cell Charge builds stacks off Meditates - Meditate-centric kits stack every one of these

items.name: Aspect of Maladaptation
items.note: 25% less damage from the element that last hit you, 30% MORE from every other. Counted at half: right for a one-element boss (after the first hit, which is always unprotected), and a straight downside against anything that mixes elements.
synergies: pin it (Advanced options) for a known single-element boss - that is the only fight it is built for
block-DR tanks (Paladin / Citadel): note DR_CAP 80 exists precisely because this item pushed a Citadel past 100%
anti-synergy: bosses with adds of other elements (Thorian summons Sheea Saint / Elementalist / Paladin) turn the -30% half on
anti-synergy with Open Hand-style DoT defence: this only reads direct attack elements

items.name: Tainted Quiver
items.note: Your first attack always puts 1 Sundered on the enemy and steals 1 energy; later attacks have an unstated chance to do it again. The Sundered lands ON the first hit, so it feeds follow-up attacks, not a nuke opener; the energy half is not priced.
synergies: Cursed enchant: +20% vs Sundered (does not stack with its +30% vs Cursed) - the Quiver guarantees the Sundered on hit one
Shattering shard (per-debuff-target, assumed 3): one more guaranteed enemy debuff
Sandstone weapon: also applies Sundered (20% per attack, 2 stacks) - the two stack toward a real Sundered uptime
Spiked Steel Ball (Vulnerable + Weakened) and Blight weapon (Cursed off Weakened/Vulnerable): a debuff-stacking kit where every extra stack pays through Shattering
anti-synergy: a Shadow Form -> Absolute Radiance -> nuke opener gets nothing, because the status is applied by the nuke itself; anti-synergy with Seraphon, which heals off your debuffs

items.name: Vainglorious Locket
items.note: +10% damage on turn 1, +5% on turn 2, nothing from turn 3 on - the reverse of a ramp: full on a turn-1 opener, ZERO on a nuke cast after two setup turns, about 2.5% averaged over a fight. Also always acts before the enemy.
synergies: zero-setup openers: a Berserker Carnage or any turn-1 nuke gets the whole 10%; Fleet enchant ('opening turn only') and the Strike First, No Mercy soul node ('first attack +25%, expires after 2 turns') live in exactly the same two-turn window
Opportunist enchant (+dmg when the target acts after you, uptime 0.5): acting first every turn makes that condition near-permanent - the uptime should read ~1 with the Locket worn
anti-synergy: Absolute Radiance / Shadow Form / Cast Amplify openers that land the hit on turn 3 - the Locket is worth 0 there
anti-synergy: ramp items (Crystalized Star, Coagulated Finger Nail, Yar'thul's Wrath) peak exactly when the Locket has expired

items.name: The Smallest Boulder
items.note: Boulder Buddy (1 energy, 14-turn cooldown): a 35-base-HP Boulder that takes every hit for you until it breaks, does not regenerate, can be healed, does not take turns, one at a time. A flat shield bought with a turn - not priced, no flat-shield kind.
synergies: Divine Promise: Divine Gift can target a summon, and the Boulder is one - 10% DR on the sponge, solo
healers: 'can still be healed' - a Saint, Jade or any outgoing-healing party keeps the Boulder alive, so its 14-turn cooldown stops mattering
full-HP gated items (Stellian Core >95%, Arborivia's Overgrowth at max HP, Striking shard): the Boulder eats hits so YOUR bar stays full - their uptime rises with it
Egg Shelmet: a second opener shield on top
Imbuement Reliquary + Vital: would grow the Boulder only if summon-HP buffs reach it, which the Boulder text casts doubt on (Vastayan's does not)
niche: a solo glass-cannon (the Assassin nuke) gets a free extra health bar every 14 turns for one energy and one turn

items.name: Eroded Blade
items.note: 10% per hit to steal 1 energy from the enemy (you gain it), at most twice a turn. Energy is a flow the ledger only costs on the opener, so it is not scored; roughly +0.1 energy per single-hit attack turn, more on multi-hit moves.
synergies: multi-hit kits: Arborivia's Leaf Thrust (2x3 hits) rolls it six times a cast - about 0.6 expected energy, and it is what the 2-a-turn cap is for
Dust Devil's Eye: its 3 extra hits presumably roll this too
energy dumps that spend the whole pool (Carnage; a Blasphemy Notch spender at 3+ energy): every stolen point is +% on the dump
Energy Manipulator (+3.75% per energy held) and Overflow (+cap): more energy in hand is damage on those
Corealloy weapon (+5% per energy read AFTER the cast) - same direction

items.name: Dust Devil's Eye
items.note: 5% per hit to strike 3 additional times with their own (unstated) base damage and scaling. Rate known, payload not - reported, not scored.
synergies: multi-hit moves roll it per hit: Leaf Thrust's 6 hits give ~26% per cast to proc at least once
per-hit procs the extra hits presumably roll too: Eroded Blade (energy), Sanguine Fang (heal), Spiked Steel Ball (+35%), Crystalized Star and Poisoner (per crit) on a 100%+ crit kit
Luck 3 stat block suits the same Luck-nuke kits that already stack per-crit effects

items.name: Open Hand
items.note: Poison, Bleed, Burn, Cold, Ghostflame and Weakened on YOU decay 2 a turn instead of 1. Halves the damage-over-time you eat and the Weakened you carry - no number for how much, so not scored - and halves the self-stacks that Reversing, Deranged Fighter and Lasting Life are paid by.
synergies: tanks against DoT-heavy bosses: the honest use - Bleed/Poison/Burn on you last half as long
Weakened decaying faster is an outgoing-damage gain on any kit that gets Weakened put on it

anti-synergy: Reversing shard (per-debuff-self), Deranged Fighter, Lasting Life, Ptera's Heart (3 Poison on you as fuel), Rabbit's Foot self-Cursed - every kit that wants statuses on itself loses half of them
Aspect of Maladaptation covers direct-hit elements; Open Hand covers the DoTs - the two are the tank's split of incoming damage

items.name: Ages Pages
items.note: +5 crit flat, already in the site's own crit figure. In Blasphemy or Tyranny, spending 50 Corrupt Power adds up to +10 more (capped at 2 stacks by a bug); in Heresy it adds nothing, because Corrupt Power is bugged there. That part is counted only in the corruption pass, never in gear choice.
synergies: Crystal Sphere (the other on-site +5 crit) - together +10 toward the 100/200/300 crit-tier snaps
Luck-scaling nukes (the standing Assassin reference wears it)
Crystalized Star and Frozen Diadem on kits that crit / apply Cold
Blasphemy or Tyranny only - never Heresy
Lucky Horns / Infected Skin compete for the same 50-CP pool each turn
items.partyValue: None - crit on your own attacks only.

items.name: Lucky Horns
items.note: +5% damage always; 50 Corrupt Power in a Corruption Form raises it to +45% for one attack, once per turn - that half is not counted in gear choice and has no FORM_GEAR slot yet (crit only).
synergies: Blasphemy dump moves (Ice Shards, The Right Angle): the spend lands on the same 3+ energy hit that consumes the Notch stack, +40% on top of Notch's +30%
Yar'thul's Wrath / Absolute Radiance - multiplicative with a stacked buff turn
Ages Pages and Infected Skin share the 50-CP pool: you cannot fund two spends a turn without a full Notch stack in Blasphemy
SPD 4 block suits initiative / Focus Step Ranger lines
items.partyValue: None - your own damage only.

items.name: Shadow Gauntlets
items.note: +5% lifesteal always; 45 Corrupt Power in a Corruption Form raises it to 25% for one attack a turn, and that half is not counted (no FORM_GEAR slot for lifesteal).
synergies: High sustainedHit kits - Berserker Carnage, Impaler Rending Barrage - since lifesteal is a share of damage dealt
Regenerative shards (0.75 / 0.7), Heavenly Prayer 10%, Elementary Resonance Dark 25%, Blasphemy 'On utility' Notch lifesteal 2-8%: all stack additively into ctx.lifesteal
Tyranny farm builds (Handaconda preferForm) where staying alive is the goal
END 4 block fits a tank stat line
items.partyValue: None - heals only you.

items.name: Infected Skin
items.note: +15 DR always (read as +15% damage reduction - the text omits the % but every other DR in the game is a percent). 50 Corrupt Power in a Corruption Form raises it to +165 for one attack a turn; that half is not counted - the wording is unclear and it would exceed the DR cap.
synergies: Berserkin Time (5% DR per Bloodlust stack to 80) and Strategist (5% per status) - additive toward DR_CAP 80
Frail Body (Calvariae dr 10), Egg Shelmet, Molten Carapace, Tear Blood Crystal - the other DR sources
Tyranny's Tyrant shields on a Handaconda-style farm build
STR 2 / END 2 block suits a Warrior / Knight tank
items.partyValue: None - reduces damage to you only.

items.name: Crystalline Spike
items.note: +5 flat damage on every hit, added to the scaled base before buffs and crit (the site's own calculator does this, the engine cannot yet). 60 Corrupt Power in a Corruption Form raises it to +40 for one attack a turn - not counted.
synergies: Carnage 1x20 (Berserker): base 1 x (1+STR/100) is ~3.4 per hit at 236 STR, so +5 per hit is roughly +150% on that move IF the game applies it per hit as the site does - a niche-defining item
Leaf Thrust 2x3 (Arborivia): +30 flat pre-multiplier, and the 40-flat spend would be +240 on the six hits
Rending Barrage's extra hit, low-base spam moves generally
STR 4 block: Warrior / Gladiator / Impaler
Blooming Eye is the same shape - the two flat sources stack per hit
items.partyValue: None - your own hits only.

items.name: Blooming Eye
items.note: +5 true flat damage (ignores defence) on your attacks - whether per hit and whether it scales with buffs is not stated, and the site does not model it. 100 Corrupt Power in a Corruption Form raises it to +35 for one attack a turn - not counted.
synergies: Same per-hit logic as Crystalline Spike if the game applies it that way - the two stack; ARC 4 makes this the Mage / Arcanist / Sorcerer twin
Against high-defence bosses true damage is worth more than flat damage; Metrom's Grasp (-40% def) makes the bypass matter less
Blasphemy with a held Notch stack is the only form with a stated Corrupt Power rate that can reach 100 every other turn
items.partyValue: None - your own hits only.

items.name: Dread Fang
items.note: Not in the game yet - the changelog lists it, no passive text exists anywhere. Stat block only (STR 2 / LCK 2). Re-price when the text lands.
synergies: A Withered Grove drop, so it will most likely be a seventh Corrupt Power spend gear like its siblings - nothing to pair until then
STR 2 / LCK 2 would suit a Strength crit hybrid line, which LEARNING.md says loses to pure Luck
items.partyValue: None known.

items.name: Empty Blade
items.note: Not in the game yet - the changelog lists it, no passive text exists anywhere. Stat block only (STR 4). Re-price when the text lands.
synergies: Stat-wise the STR 4 twin of Crystalline Spike and Everbeating Drums - a plain Strength stick until it has a passive
Withered Grove drop, so probably a Corrupt Power spend gear when released
items.partyValue: None known.

items.name: Faded Heirloom
items.note: Not in the game yet - the changelog lists it, no passive text exists anywhere. Stat block only (LCK 1, the weakest stat block of any gear). Re-price when the text lands - with 1 stat point its passive will be the whole item.
synergies: Nothing until it has text; a 1-Luck stick is worth half a crit point and loses every slot to any 4-stat gear
items.partyValue: None known.

items.name: Ring of Heroism
items.note: Not in the game yet - the changelog lists it, no passive text exists anywhere. Stat block only (STR 3). Re-price when the text lands.
synergies: Withered Grove drop, so probably a Corrupt Power spend gear when released; STR 3 suits Warrior / Gladiator / Impaler lines
items.partyValue: None known.

items.name: Reality Watch
items.note: Chronos (0 energy, 12 turn cooldown) saves your HP and energy and rewinds both to those values 3 turns later - so cast it at full HP and a full pool, dump everything for 3 turns, and get the pool and the health back; it will not revive you inside the window, and it rewinds heals and energy you gained too. Not counted: the heal is whatever you lost, which needs incoming damage the engine does not model, and the energy refund needs a sustained energy ledger it does not have.
synergies: Pool-dump kits: Blasphemy's Notch on 3+ energy moves (Ice Shards, Miner's The Right Angle), Absolute Radiance (cost 4) - three turns of full-pool spending refunded every 12
Stellian Core is the same slot, so NOT pairable; but any full-HP-gated race passive (Arborivia's Overgrowth) is re-armed when the rewind puts you back to full
ANTI: healers and Astra's Utor - a heal received inside the window is rewound away
ANTI: low-HP stance classes (Berserker Bloodlust, Impaler Bloody Berserker, Brawler Bruiser) - rewinding to full HP undoes the stance they fight in
Its cooldown is N/A type, so neither STR 110 nor ARC 110 shortens it
items.partyValue: Solo: it rewinds your own HP and energy only.

items.name: Narthana's Sigil
items.note: When you heal 270 HP it deals X damage and heals allies for X, and X is written as 'scales on level' and never stated, so it cannot be scored; the healer keeps it through ROLE_ITEMS instead. The passive-regen boost in the text is marked unconfirmed and stays unpriced.
synergies: Narthana's Leaf (+75% outgoing healing, already in gearPctBonuses) - raises heal size, so the 270 HP proc fires more often
Saint's Holy Grace, Astra's Utor (20-40% max HP every 7 turns), Way of Life, Lifesong, Bard's Curar Forte, Holy Emissary - anything that raises heal-per-turn IS the proc rate
Needs 60 End on a Saint, or ~102 total with Astra, to reach a 270 HP heal (LEARNING verified fact)
Party only: solo the ally heal is wasted and the damage is the only half left
items.partyValue: The entire payload is party-facing: X damage plus X healing to every ally per 270 HP healed; solo it is only the unstated damage.

items.name: Shifting Hourglass
items.note: Sands Of Time (1 energy, 15 turn cooldown, 5 uses a fight) puts you in Heavy Stun for a turn and, if you did not lose 20% HP while stunned, grants +20% damage and +20% DR - the text gives no duration, and the site stacks it as permanent (x1.20 per use, capped at 5). Never up on the opener (you are stunned on it) and it costs the cast turn plus the stun turn, which the engine must charge.
synergies: Avoidance and DR that cover the stun turn so the 20%-HP cancel never fires: Lightspeed autododge, Dust Storm's phase, Holy Shield, Calvariae's Brittle Cure (+25% DR for 4 turns) cast the turn before
Long boss fights: 5 uses at cd 15 need 60+ turns to reach x2.49; short fights get one stack
Tank archetypes value the +20% DR half as much as the damage half
ANTI: low-HP stance classes (Berserker, Impaler, Brawler) - a hit for 20% of a low pool cancels the buff and the stun turn is the one they cannot afford
ANTI: one-turn-window openers (Shadow Form's break attack) - the stun turn breaks the rotation timing
Type N/A: neither STR 110 nor ARC 110 shortens the 15 turn cooldown
items.partyValue: Solo: the damage buff and the DR are on you only.

items.name: Metrom's Amulet
items.note: On a kill the overkill becomes an AoE base against everything else (20 into a 15 HP enemy gives a 5 base AoE), it can crit and bypasses reflects. Not counted: every number here is single-target, where it does nothing, and it cannot damage Seraphon or Arkhaia at all - in the Metrom's Vessel raid it heals the boss.
synergies: Overkill nukes in multi-enemy content: the Assassin's crit Poison Fan or a full-pool Ice Shards into trash turns the surplus into a second hit on everything
Miner's The Right Angle already hits everything, so its overkill on the first death splashes again
Everbeating Drums (20% on hit to splash) is the same job from a gear slot
ANTI: any single boss, and especially Seraphon / Arkhaia (immune) and the Metrom's Vessel raid (it heals MV)
items.partyValue: Solo damage effect; in a party it only matters that someone else does not take the kill.

items.name: Heaven's Authority
items.note: Calling Light (2 energy, 9 turn cooldown) summons a random 250 HP Sheea - Saint, Paladin or Elementalist - that starts with Strike and Skyward Bolt and gets its full Super Class kit only if you carry its weapon type; at or below 20% HP you get two. Not counted: the engine scores your sheet, and a summon with its own kit and no stated damage has no column.
synergies: Darkwraith's Spirit Wraith: under 50% HP your summons gain 6% lifesteal paid to YOU - a Sheea is a summon, and the same low-HP stance is what triggers the second one at 20%
Low-HP stance classes (Berserker, Impaler, Brawler, Darkwraith) sit where Calling Light doubles
Vastayan's Spirit Caller (+20% summon HP) and Imbuement Reliquary (summons gain your enchant) - if a Sheea counts as a summon for them, which the text does not say
Type N/A: neither STR 110 nor ARC 110 shortens the 9 turn cooldown
A Saint Sheea is a healer body; on a healer build that is a second set of heals the numbers here miss
items.partyValue: It is effectively an extra party member: a 250 HP body with a healer, tank or caster kit that reaches the whole team; solo it is still a second body, but a Saint Sheea's heals have nobody else to land on.

items.name: Darksigil
items.note: After six status applications on opponents (the text says '6 different instances', which reads as six applications rather than six distinct types - unconfirmed) it fires a Dark Orb for Level x2 damage (100 at level 50) and puts 2 Vulnerable and 2 Weakened on every enemy. Not counted: a flat, count-triggered burst has no kind, and the engine does not simulate a rotation long enough to say how often six applications happen; it is dead weight on a kit that applies nothing.
synergies: Alchemist's Dangerous Mixture: 3 stacks of 3 debuffs at once - if each stack is an instance, that is 9 and the Orb fires on turn 1
Poisoner (poison per crit) with Leaf Thrust's 3 hits, Ptera's Heart, Snorb (cold), Sandstone (sundered), Lights Out (3 Blinded + 1 Stunned) - status-per-hit kits reach six fastest
The Orb's Vulnerable and Weakened are themselves statuses that Reversing, Deranged Fighter and Tyranny's Condemned read
NOT pairable with Chaos Orb - same artifact slot; the current note claims this pairing and it cannot happen
Wicked Crown converts Physical to Dark, which does nothing for the Orb (its damage is flat, not a move)
items.partyValue: Solo trigger, but the payload hits and debuffs ALL opponents, so on a team every ally's attacks into a Vulnerable/Weakened target benefit.

items.name: Stellian Core
items.note: +30% damage, +20% DR and +15% crit chance, only while above 95% of max HP - so it is fully up on the opening turn by definition and worth nothing once anything has hit you. Counted at 35% long-run uptime (an assumption), with the whole +30%/+15 credited to the opener, and flipped to 80%/5% on classes built to fight healthy or hurt.
synergies: Shadow Form: Invisible means not being hit, so the Assassin's setup turns keep Stellian up until the nuke lands - the standing Assassin nuke is built on this
Arborivia's Overgrowth (+10 crit / +10% DR / +20 SPD cast at max HP) shares the gate: both up on the opener, both lost together
Avoidance keeps it up: Lightspeed autododge, Dust Storm's 10% phase; heavy DR delays the drop
Re-arming after a hit: Astra's Utor (20-40% max HP every 7), Shadow Gauntlets / Sanguine Fang lifesteal, Broken Bones flat heal - anything that tops you back over 95%
ANTI: Venia's Permuth costs 5% of your HP - that lands you AT 95% and the gate is 'above 95%', so the mark's own buff switches the artifact off
ANTI: self-damage and self-status kits - Ptera's Heart self-poison, Rabbit's Foot self-curse, Calvariae's Brittle Cure (20% current HP) - each drops you under the gate on their own
ANTI: HP_STANCE classes (Berserker, Impaler, Brawler, Darkwraith), already handled by HP_GATED at 5%
items.partyValue: Solo: all three effects are on your own sheet.

items.name: Chaos Orb
items.note: Whenever you apply a status there is a 33% chance to apply one more at random (never Heavy Stun, Fractured, Hex, Stun or a boss-only status; Ghostflame only as a Dullahan). Counted under Procs as extra statuses per turn scaled by how status-heavy the kit is, so a kit that applies nothing gets nothing.
synergies: Status-per-hit kits: Poisoner with Leaf Thrust (3 hits), Alchemist's Dangerous Mixture (9 stacks at once), Ptera's Heart, Snorb, Sandstone, Lights Out
Whatever it adds is read by Reversing, Deranged Fighter, Lasting Life and Tyranny's Condemned
Dullahan unlocks Ghostflame in its random pool
NOT pairable with Darksigil - same artifact slot
ANTI: pure-damage kits that apply nothing (the proc never rolls)
items.partyValue: Solo trigger; the extra status lands on the enemy, so allies whose passives read enemy statuses benefit incidentally.

items.name: Arkhaia's Visage
items.note: Infernal Pledge (1 energy, 8 turn cooldown, Dark) links an enemy for 3 turns and shares the damage you take with it, self-damage excluded - so it is a defensive cooldown up 3 turns in 8 that also hurts the target. Not counted: the text never says what share goes to the enemy, and pricing it needs the incoming damage the engine does not model.
synergies: ARC 110: it is a Dark-type move, so the Arcane milestone shortens its 8 turn cooldown
Tank archetypes and Lesser Absorb (5% of an ally's incoming damage pulled onto you) - damage you absorb for the team is shared onward to the enemy
Brittle Cure / Holy Shield / Heavenly Prayer stack DR under it, reducing what is shared and what you keep alike
ANTI: Calvariae's self-damage (Broken Bones, Brittle Cure's 20% HP) is explicitly excluded from the share
Shard of Blight is +25% to Dark MOVES; the shared damage is not a move, so it does not apply
items.partyValue: Solo effect on your own incoming damage; with Lesser Absorb an ally's damage becomes enemy damage through you.

items.name: Paranoxian Crux
items.note: Rewrites your health: max HP x1.5, then real HP set to 10% of that (15% of the original) with the other ~135% turned into Shield HP that stacks with other shields; Congeal Flesh (X energy, 6 turn cooldown, Ice) restores 15xX% of the shield, so 7 energy is a full refill. Not counted: the engine has HP and no Shield HP, and pretending they are the same misprices every tank that wears this - note also that the site's row shows an 85% shield where the text says 135%.
synergies: Other shield sources stack: Blacksmith's Jury Rigging (10 HP shield scaling END/150), Blasphemy's Shield (5-25% of the hit) - the text says shields stack
ARC 110 shortens Congeal Flesh (Ice); a caster tank refills a 135% shield every ~5 turns for a full pool

NICHE (unconfirmed by the text): if damage hits the shield first and the class passives read real HP, an Impaler (Bloody Berserker, +1% per 1% HP missing) or Berserker (Bloodlust) can sit near 1 HP of a 15% pool behind a 135% shield - the strongest low-HP tank line in the game if it works, nothing if it does not
ANTI: healing that targets real HP overheals a 15% pool - Astra's Utor, healPctPerTurn sources, incoming-healing stacks are mostly wasted
ANTI: Narthana's Leaf (-25% max HP) shrinks both pools
Energy spent on Congeal Flesh is energy not spent on Blasphemy's Notch dumps - the two compete for the pool
items.partyValue: Solo: it rewrites your own health only.

items.name: Ancient Insignia
items.note: A random stance that re-rolls every 3 turns: Rock is 15% DR (counted at one in three, 5% on average), Paper is 1 Resist per debuff on you and Scissors is 5 Energy, neither counted. Written in Stone (1 energy, 12 turn cooldown, Physical) forces a switch that lasts 4 turns - the text does not say you choose the stance, so it cannot honestly raise Rock's share.
synergies: Paper pays self-status kits: Ptera's Heart self-poison, Rabbit's Foot self-curse, Darkblood sharing statuses back - every debuff on you is a Resist
Scissors is +5 energy roughly every 9 turns on average: real fuel for Blasphemy's Notch dumps (Ice Shards, The Right Angle) once the ledger can count sustained energy
STR 110 shortens Written in Stone (Physical); Wicked Crown converts Physical moves to Dark on the site, which would hand that cut to ARC 110 instead if the conversion covers buffs - unverified
Tank archetypes take the Rock third; nothing here helps an opener
items.partyValue: Solo: every stance is on your own sheet.

items.name: Celestial Emblem
items.note: A downside: when you start a fight against a Goblin, Night Raider, Sentient Darkness, Star Slime or Arkhaia they become empowered with enemy-specific effects, and the text states no reward for it. Nothing here helps your own sheet, and against Arkhaia it makes the fight harder.
synergies: None positive; it is a challenge modifier for those five enemies and the text names no drop or bonus
ANTI: Cult of Thanasius hosts (Arkhaia rank-20 host) - wearing it into your own Arkhaia fight empowers the boss
items.partyValue: Whoever starts the fight empowers the enemy for the whole party.

items.name: Estella (24%)

effects.name: Hyper Rage
