effects.note: +25% damage once you dip under 50% max HP (40% before level 35); unlike Berserker's Bloodlust it 'remains for the rest of the fight', so it never drops when you heal back up. Zero on an opener; 0.35 on a neutral class, lifted to the 0.8 stance uptime on a committed low-HP class (existing behaviour, keep).

effects.name: Enduring Fighter (defence)
effects.note: 'Permanent 10% defense buff' below the threshold, kept for the rest of the fight with Hyper Rage. Same gate and uptime as the damage half. 'Defense buff' is priced on the engine's only defence column (dr), as Brittle Cure and Tense Up are.

effects.name: Enduring Fighter (healing)
effects.note: +50% healing for two turns after the trigger, permanent while you stay below the threshold, 2 turns or until attacked above it. The 50% is stated; whether it is incoming or outgoing healing is not - priced as INCOMING because it triggers on your own HP and the race is not a healer. Flip to outHealPct if the owner says otherwise.

effects.name: Tense Up
effects.note: +30% true defence for 4 turns every 6 (uptime 4/6). 'True' is read as DR that penetration does not touch; 2 energy on an opener competes with the nuke for the pool and is not charged beyond the setup's cost field.

items.note: Below 50% max HP (40% before Hyper Rage) Estella gets +25% damage and +10% defence for the rest of the fight, plus a 50% healing buff while under the line; Tense Up adds +30% true defence for 4 of every 6 turns. All three numbers are stated; the healing direction and the defence-to-DR mapping are the only readings.
synergies: Impaler (Bloody Berserker) / Berserker (Bloodlust) / Brawler (Bruiser) / Darkwraith (Spirit Wraith): every HP_STANCE 'low' class lifts Hyper Rage and the 10% DR to the 0.8 stance uptime - Estella is the race those classes want
Molten Carapace (below 40% HP) and Executing shards (conditional-hp-below) sit on the same side of the line; Stellian Core (above 95%) and Striking shards conflict
Vastayan's Spirit Awakening self-hit (27.5% HP) and Calvariae-style HP costs push you under 50% deliberately - a cheap Hyper Rage trigger on a build that wants it
Tense Up + Brittle Cure / Holy Light: DR setups stack on blockDr toward DR_CAP, so a tank rotation can open with Tense Up and stay under the cap
Once triggered the buffs persist through healing, so a Saint/healer pairing does not switch Hyper Rage off the way it switches off Bruiser
items.partyValue: Self only: every buff is on Estella's own sheet and Tense Up says 'the user'.
items.niche: the race for any class already built to fight hurt; gives a bruiser 25% damage + 10% DR that never turns off once earned

items.name: Stultus (20%)

effects.name: Innate Ability (Speed to Crit)
effects.note: 10 Speed = 1 crit chance, capped at +100. Applied on the stat page (builder.js:1135-1217) and mirrored by the engine's 'Stultus innate' QUIRK hook (unfloored, matching the site). Nothing to add; pricing it in PASSIVES would double-count.

effects.name: Focus Step (speed)
effects.note: KEEP the existing entry: LVL*2 flat Speed for 4 turns every 7 (+100 at level 50, model.js:210). On a Stultus that same +100 Speed is +10 crit through the innate for the same 4 turns - verify the setup's buffedCrit path (optimize.js:790) runs the innate hook on the buffed Speed, otherwise the crit half of the setup is silently lost.

effects.name: Focus Step (auto-dodge)
effects.note: 'The ability to automatically dodge a move, including moves which typically cannot be dodged' - one guaranteed avoidance per cast, undodgeable moves included. The engine's dodge kind is a per-hit percentage with no setup column, and one dodge per 7 turns is not a percentage the text gives, so it is listed, not scored.

effects.name: Focus Step (recoil)
effects.note: COST: the quote reads 'When it ends, take recoil damage.' The effect text never states the amount, so it cannot be priced as an HP cost - but it is a cost and the write-up must say the buff is not free. Ask the owner for the figure.

effects.name: Vanishing Drive
effects.note: An out-of-combat speed item ('cannot be used in combat'). Nothing for a fight.

items.note: Speed converts to crit at 10:1 (on-site, capped +100) and Focus Step adds LVL*2 flat Speed plus one guaranteed dodge for 4 of every 7 turns - but the buff ends with unstated recoil damage, which is a cost the current entry does not mention.
synergies: Ranger's Flourish (+25/+48 flat Speed) stacks with Focus Step's +100: two flat Speed buffs on a Speed-scaling kit, and on a Stultus both become crit as well
Crystalized Star / Poisoner / any per-crit stacker: a higher crit rate from the innate lands more stacks per turn
Any SPD-scaling move (Veneri's Burst Trap is SPD/LCK) reads the buffed Speed directly
Anti-synergy: Vastic Glaive's SPD branch is BUGGED, so a Stultus whose highest stat is Speed gets the dead branch on every proc - keep Luck or Strength ahead of Speed if wearing it
Ophimar has the better raw LCK/SPD block but no conversion; Stultus wins when the kit scales on Speed and wants crit for free
items.partyValue: Self only: Focus Step buffs 'the user'.
items.niche: the Speed-scaling crit build: every point of Speed is damage and crit at once

items.name: Nisse (20%)

effects.name: Circuit Charge (energy)
effects.note: +3 energy on a 0-cost, 5-turn cooldown - half a full pool (cap 6) in one turn, which is what makes a 3-energy dump castable on turn two.

effects.name: Circuit Charge (self-cost)
effects.note: COST: 2 Vulnerable on yourself - you take 20% more damage per the site's status list (builder.js:6430) for those stacks. It is also a self-status that Reversing shards, Deranged Fighter and Lasting Life read, so on those kits the cost partly pays for itself. Race actives are already text-scanned for statuses (optimize.js kitFor comment) - verify it registers once, not twice.

effects.name: Energy Surge
effects.note: 'A chance to gain extra energy on your turn' with no figure; the site's races table carries no nrgChance for Nisse either. Not counted - compare Corvolus's Energy Chance, same problem.

effects.name: Potion Duplication
effects.note: Crafting only. Nothing for a fight.

items.note: Magically Charged stays as it is (+15% Fire and Magic, element-gated). Circuit Charge is the unpriced half: +3 energy for free every 5 turns, paid for with 2 Vulnerable on yourself - a dump enabler the engine cannot score until it has an energy-gain setup kind.
synergies: Berserker's Carnage: +20% per energy past the first and it eats the whole pool - Circuit Charge on the turn before is up to +60% on that Carnage when the pool was short
Blasphemy's Notch only pays a 3+ energy move (Ice Shards, The Right Angle): Circuit Charge is what lets a 3-cost dump follow a setup turn instead of waiting for regen
Energy Manipulator (+3.75% per energy held, 22.5 at 6) and Corealloy read the pool - filling it for free is damage on both
Reversing shards (per-debuff-self, 3 of them in the standing Assassin nuke) and Impaler's Deranged Fighter turn the 2 self-Vulnerable from a pure cost into a buff
Ophimar's Advanced Ecdysis would halve the self-Vulnerable duration - but it is a different race, so this is a comparison not a pairing
Magically Charged wants a Fire/Magic kit: Affinity Mastery (Holy, Magic) and Elemental Master gear stack on the same moves; Wicked Crown does NOT help (it converts Physical to Dark, not to Magic)
items.partyValue: Self only: the energy and the Vulnerable both land on Nisse.
items.niche: the energy-dump race: a free +3 energy every 5 turns feeds Carnage, Notch dumps and Energy Manipulator kits

items.name: Vastayan (9%)

effects.name: Affinity Boost
effects.note: RESTORE: the data now reads 'Your Magic and Hex affinity skills get a 10% damage buff' (data-race-moves.js), and the site's own _affinityRestricted map lists it as Magic+Hex. The knowledge.js note that it has no text is stale - this is the Daminos pattern, the data caught up. Full value behind the element gate, not a smeared uptime.

effects.name: Spirit Caller
effects.note: KEEP: summons +20% HP, Skeletons +50%. The sylph's 5% max-HP regen per turn is unmodelled (note). The site says Boulder Buddy is explicitly NOT boosted.

effects.name: Spirit Awakening (buff)
effects.note: KEEP the +50% summon damage. The +15% to all stats is not priced: the site approximates it as +15% damage in its toggle list (builder.js:5387, its own comment) and the text says the Endurance part converts to DR at an unstated rate; a statPct setup kind would carry it honestly, a flat dmgPct 15 would be the site's guess not the text's number.

effects.name: Spirit Awakening (self-cost)
effects.note: COST, currently uncharged: on the 4th turn you take 27.5% max HP damage ('can be affected by Hex' - worse under Hex) and are heavily stunned through your next turn. Add SELF_STUN['Spirit Awakening'] = 1 and an HP cost; the setup scorer has no turn-cost column, so until it does the write-up must say 4 turns of buff cost 4 energy, one lost turn and a quarter of your HP.

effects.name: Call Sylph / Wind Bolt / Gale Pulse
effects.note: Call Sylph (2 energy, cd 7) summons a 35-base-HP sylph whose own moves (Wind Bolt 5 dmg 0-cost, Gale Pulse 7 dmg AoE 2-cost, STR/100+ARC/100) are stored as 'Sylph' slot Actives in the race learns. They are the SUMMON's moves - when race actives are switched into kitFor they must be excluded or the player scores a free 0-cost attack.

effects.name: Tail / High Jump
effects.note: Movement flavour. Nothing for a fight.

items.note: Affinity Boost is +10% to Magic and Hex - the data now states it and the site gates it the same way, so it goes back in as an element-gated dmgPct. Spirit Caller and Spirit Awakening's +50% summon damage stay; Spirit Awakening's 27.5% HP hit and one-turn heavy stun on turn 4 are a real cost that is written in the note and charged nowhere.
synergies: Darkwraith (Spirit Wraith: summons' lifesteal paid to you under 50% HP) and Necromancer skeletons (+50% HP) are the summoner classes Spirit Caller is for; the Spirit Awakening self-hit also drops you toward Darkwraith's 50% line
Impaler's Bloody Berserker (+1% per 1% HP missing) and Estella's Hyper Rage turn the 27.5% self-damage into a damage buff - the one pairing where the cost pays
Affinity Boost + Affinity Mastery (Holy, Magic) / Elemental Master gear stack on Magic moves; Hex-typed kits get it too. Wicked Crown converts Physical to Dark, not Magic, so it does not unlock this
Vastic Glaive procs at 16.6% on a Vastayan instead of 12.5% (already a QUIRK) - the Luck branch is +80% crit on the next attack
Do not pair Spirit Caller with Boulder Buddy expecting +20% HP: the site data says the boulder is excluded
items.partyValue: Self only: Spirit Awakening buffs 'the user' and 'their summons'; the summons are yours.
items.niche: the summoner race, and a Magic/Hex caster's +10%; Spirit Awakening is a burst window you pay for with a quarter of your HP and a turn

items.name: Veneri (6%)

effects.name: Gold Rush
effects.note: +0.2% damage per 500 gold, capped at +20% at 50k. Unconditional and element-agnostic. The site models it behind a gold slider (builder.js:4043, 5123) that defaults to 0 and model.js does not read it, so it is NOT on-site for the engine. Priced at the cap on the assumption of a full wallet - the same kind of assumption as maxed health nodes - and the write-up must say '20% assumes 50k gold held; 0 at 0'. Oppulence Cutter spends 1000 a cast, which is -0.4% until it refills.

effects.name: Enchant Affinity
effects.note: 'A higher chance of proccing enchants' - no figure. Not counted; it raises whatever the enchant's own proc rate is (Sanguine Fang's 25%, Vastic Glaive's 12.5%).

effects.name: Burst Trap
effects.note: 2 energy, cd 6, 10 base Fire, scaling 'SPD/LCK': a trap under yourself that fires when the enemy melees you, up to twice in 3 turns. A conditional counter, not a nuke - up to 2 x 10 base if the enemy melees, nothing against a caster. Race actives are not in the scored kit; listed.

effects.name: Potion Quaffer
effects.note: One extra Low Tier potion per fight. Consumables are not modelled.

effects.name: Oppulence Cutter
effects.note: 0 energy, cd 10, 10 base Magic (STR/75 + ARC/75): consumes 1000 gold per cast (fails under 5k) and raises 'your highest invested stat by (?)' - the buff is unstated, so the move is a 0-cost Magic hit with a gold cost and nothing else priceable. Being Magic it takes Affinity Mastery / Elemental Master and Nisse-style Magic bonuses, not Wicked Crown.

items.note: Gold Rush is a permanent, unconditional +20% damage at 50k gold (0.2% per 500) - stronger than any element-gated race passive, and worth nothing to a player with an empty wallet, so it is priced at the cap with the wallet assumption named. The rest of the kit is economy: enchant proc rate, an extra potion, a melee-triggered trap and a gold-burning Magic hit with an unstated stat buff.
synergies: Every damage build: Gold Rush has no element or HP gate, so it multiplies with Blasphemy, Shard of Blight, Absolute Radiance and anything else - a rich Veneri is a flat +20% on top of all of it
Burst Trap scales SPD/LCK: a Luck nuke build (the Assassin) or a Speed build gets the counter for free, but only against melee mobs
Enchant Affinity favours proc enchants over flat ones: Sanguine Fang (25% on hit to heal 10%), Vastic Glaive (12.5% proc) and Eroded Blade (10% energy steal) all get an unstated bump
Oppulence Cutter is Magic-typed: Affinity Mastery (Holy, Magic) and Elemental Master gear apply; it does not need Wicked Crown
Anti-synergy with itself: Oppulence Cutter spends the gold Gold Rush is counting - trivial at 50k (-0.4% per cast) but real for a player near the 5k floor
items.partyValue: Self only: Gold Rush reads your own gold; Burst Trap sits under you.
items.niche: the whale race: a permanent +20% damage for anyone who keeps 50k gold banked - not a combat kit, a bank balance

items.name: Ophimar (6%)

effects.name: Ecdysis
effects.note: Poison, Bleed and Burn on YOU decay 2 a turn instead of 1: halves incoming DoT duration. No damage-taken figure to price, and an anti-synergy for anything that reads your own statuses (Reversing shards, Deranged Fighter, Lasting Life) because they fall off twice as fast.

effects.name: Sharp Scales
effects.note: 'Start the battle off with 4 turns of Thorns.' Thorns is a reflect buff whose per-hit figure is stated nowhere in the data (the site's status list has no Thorns entry), so it cannot be priced. It is a buff, not a debuff, so Reversing does not read it.

effects.name: Blacktongue
effects.note: 0 energy, cd 10: your next attack deals 'additional damage equal to Poison stacks, then decay Poison by 1, repeats per stack' - i.e. 1+2+...+n extra damage for n stacks, in an unstated unit (flat HP reads as tiny; a percentage would be huge). Gated on enemy Poison, which only a poison kit applies. Unit unstated, so a note - ask the owner.

effects.name: Advanced Ecdysis
effects.note: Ecdysis now also decays Vulnerable, Weakened and Cripple on you at 2 a turn. Same shape: a defensive cleanse with no number, and it halves the payoff of self-debuff kits.

effects.name: New Skin, New Me
effects.note: Meditate decays every Ecdysis status by a further 2. A cleanse turn; the engine does not model meditate turns beyond Focused Mind.

items.note: Ophimar's kit is entirely self-status decay (Poison/Bleed/Burn, later Vulnerable/Weakened/Cripple, and a meditate cleanse), four opening turns of Thorns with no stated reflect figure, and Blacktongue, which converts enemy Poison stacks into extra damage in an unstated unit. Nothing here carries a number the engine can score; the race's real value is its base 3 Luck / 4 Speed, which the site's stat maths already applies.
synergies: Assassin Luck nuke / any crit build: base LCK 3 SPD 4 is the best crit stat block among common races - the honest comparison is Ophimar's raw block vs Stultus's Speed-to-crit conversion, decided by whether the kit scales Speed

Poison kits (Assassin's Poison Fan, Poisoner mastery applying poison per crit, Ptera's Heart): Blacktongue is the only thing that spends enemy Poison stacks as burst - a real niche once the unit is known
Boreas / self-DoT costs: Ecdysis halves what Bleed, Burn and Poison do to you, so HP-cost kits and DoT-heavy bosses hurt Ophimar less

Anti-synergy: Reversing shards (per-debuff-self), Impaler's Deranged Fighter and Lasting Life all read your own statuses - Advanced Ecdysis makes them fall off twice as fast, so do not pair Ophimar with a Reversing build
Anti-synergy with Nisse-style self-Vulnerable plays for the same reason, though it would halve that cost
items.partyValue: Self only: every effect is a status on Ophimar's own sheet; Thorns reflects onto whoever hits Ophimar.
items.niche: a crit-stat block with a self-cleanse kit; a poison-burst niche with Blacktongue that cannot be priced until its damage unit is stated

items.name: Drauga (6%)

effects.name: Vampiric Crits
effects.note: 15% of the attack's damage back on every crit. On the standing Assassin nuke (crit past 100%) that is a flat 15% lifesteal - triple Shadow Gauntlets' 5% and Siphoning's 5% - and near nothing on a 10%-crit tank. The site prints the heal line in its damage calc (builder.js:4420) but it is display only, so the engine does not double-count.

effects.name: Enhanced Bloodlust
effects.note: 12.5-15% damage 'for the rest of the fight when you kill an enemy' - priced at the range's midpoint. ZERO on an opener and zero for the whole of a single-boss fight (the model fights one enemy: a kill ends it), so the 0.5 uptime is an assumption about multi-enemy encounters and must say so. The Speed buff alongside it is unstated (note).

effects.name: Bloodlust (innate)
effects.note: A Speed buff on kill for the rest of the fight, no figure. Not counted.

effects.name: Illusion Cage
effects.note: 2 energy, cd 8: a trap on yourself OR a teammate - the first enemy attack targeting them is cancelled and the enemy takes 2 stun (boss ultimates excepted). One guaranteed avoidance plus two enemy turns, on an ally if you want; the engine has no enemy-stun column and its dodge kind is per-hit, so it is listed.

effects.name: Blood Shards
effects.note: 3 energy, cd 9, 1.2 x 6 hits Magic (STR/80 + ARC/80), heals you for the damage dealt (100% lifesteal on this move), and if the enemy is Vulnerable the last shard applies 3 Bleed. Race actives are not in the scored kit (LEARNING gap 1); when they are, this is a 3-cost dump that Blasphemy's Notch pays and a six-hit stacker.

items.note: Crits heal 15% of the hit - a lifesteal that scales with crit chance, so it is a flat 15% on a 100%-crit build and nothing on a tank; Enhanced Bloodlust's 12.5-15% needs a kill first, so it is zero on an opener and zero against a lone boss. Illusion Cage cancels one attack and stuns the enemy 2 turns, on an ally if placed there; Blood Shards is a 3-energy six-hit Magic move that heals for all its damage.
synergies: 100%-crit builds (the standing Assassin nuke, a Stultus Speed-crit kit): Vampiric Crits becomes a flat 15% lifesteal, the largest sustain a DPS race offers - Drauga is the crit race that also survives
Blasphemy's Notch pays only 3+ energy moves: Blood Shards is a 3-cost dump, and a Nisse-style energy top-up is exactly what casts it on turn two
Per-hit stackers on Blood Shards' 6 hits: Crystalized Star (+10 Luck per crit), Poisoner (poison per crit), Spiked Steel Ball (35% per-hit proc EV) - LEARNING gap 2 is the thing that would price this
Enemy Vulnerable from Spiked Steel Ball, Impaling Strike Proficiency or Blaze Proficiency unlocks Blood Shards' 3 Bleed, which then feeds Siphoning (5% lifesteal vs bleeding) and any Impaler kit
Illusion Cage on the party healer: a support play with no scoring column - list it under party value
Enhanced Bloodlust is a farming buff, not a boss buff: it pairs with AoE kits (Gale Pulse, Blaze Proficiency AoE) that kill adds early, and is dead weight in a one-target fight
items.partyValue: Illusion Cage can be placed on a teammate: that ally's next targeted attack is cancelled and the attacker eats 2 stun, so it protects the healer or a low-HP ally rather than only yourself; the lifesteal and the damage buff are self only.
items.niche: the crit-sustain race: on a 100%-crit kit it is a flat 15% lifesteal, and Blood Shards is a 3-cost Notch dump once race actives are scored

items.name: Corvolus (3%)
items.note: Affinity Mastery: +30% damage on Holy and Magic affinity moves. Always on, gated on element, priced at full value on matching moves only.
synergies: Cast Amplify (own race: +20% to the same Holy/Magic moves, so a Holy or Magic opener gets both)
Arcane Ritual (own race, ~40% chance buff on the same elements)
Saint (Or) / Paladin (Or) / Citadel (Or) Holy attacks
Wizard / Elementalist (Or) / Lancer (N) / Impaler (Ch) Magic attacks
Element Mastery capstone (Magic/Holy included)
ARC 110 milestone (non-Physical cooldown cut) plus Cast Amplify's -1 cooldown
Wicked Crown: turns Physical into Dark, so Cast Amplify/Arcane Ritual pay but Affinity Mastery does NOT (Dark is not Holy/Magic)
Shard of Blight only with a crowned or Dark kit, and then only with Cast Amplify, not Affinity Mastery
items.partyValue: Affinity Mastery is self-only. Cast Amplify can be put on one ally instead of yourself, and Arcane Ritual reaches the party (per its quote), so Corvolus is a real support pick for a Holy/Magic/Fire/Nature/Ice/Dark carry.

items.name: Daminos (3%)
items.note: Mulligan Realm: all allies get ~21% more outgoing healing for 4 turns every 10 (level 40, cost 3). The mulligan (survive a fatal blow) is presumably bugged and not priced.
synergies: Saint (Or): Cleansing Prayer and Holy Grace scale with outgoing healing; Holy Emissary +35% stacks with Outgoing Healing +15% and Mulligan Realm ~21%
Jade weapon series (+30% incoming and outgoing healing)
Surprise Package scroll: a Nature trigger fires 'Daminos Restructure' plus a cleanse
The builder.js item that regens 1% max HP per missing life (counts Daminos bonus lives)
Party healers: Mulligan Realm scales every ally healer, not only you
items.partyValue: Mulligan Realm gives the ~21% outgoing-healing buff to every ally, so in a party with two healers it is worth roughly twice the solo figure. Restructure can target an ally tank as a 3-turn regen.

items.name: Dullahan (1%)
items.note: Bonus Stat Points: already in the point budget through model.js at the site's rate of 1 per 10 levels. The game text says 3; that conflict is flagged for the owner, not re-priced.
synergies: Chaotic Cascade: can add Ghostflame only on a Dullahan
Conversion - Burning: detonates Ghostflamed for a flat 3.5% max HP
Multi-status kits (Chilling Winds-style Cold/Vulnerable/Weakened): each unique status adds 0.35% to Ghostflame ticks
Fire moves (Ghostflame, Lifeless Skull) take Cast Amplify from a Corvolus ally
Fire Resistance against Fire-heavy bosses
Anti-synergy: Dragon weapon (+15% vs Burning) does not count Ghostflame; Blazing Perforator does not work on Ghostflame
items.partyValue: None of Dullahan's passives reach allies. Ghostflame raises the whole party's damage only through statuses, and nothing prices that.

items.name: Vydeer (1%)
items.note: Crit Buildup: +1.5% crit chance each turn, capped at +15% after 10 turns. Zero on the opening turn; about +7.5% at an assumed 5 turns. Not scored until the engine can ramp crit on a race passive.
synergies: Luck/crit builds sitting just under a crit tier: +15% by turn 10 can cross a tier on a long boss fight
Mind's Eye reflects can crit and proc enchants, weapon passives and shards, so Crit Buildup and Luck feed the reflect too
Lightspeed (Ranger): Sense auto-dodges may count as dodges (unstated); flag, do not price
Anti-synergy: Arborivia/Shadow Form nuke openers; Vydeer's value is all late in a fight, the opposite of a one-turn burst
Party: Soul Reversal at 8+ Sense gives allies 2 turns of invincibility
items.partyValue: Soul Reversal at 8+ Sense stacks makes every ally invincible for 2 turns. That is a real party defensive cooldown, not priceable as a percentage. Crit Buildup and Sense are self-only.

items.name: Boreas (1%)
items.note: Frost Stacks: +20% damage and +10% DR per stack, gained per Ice move used, up to +200% damage / 70% DR; each non-Ice move drops a stack. Zero on an opener and only real on an Ice-only rotation. Not scored until a per-use, element-gated stacking kind exists.
synergies: Frozen Diadem (RACE_TECH Permafrost, needsStatus cold): Cold Application and Chilling Winds satisfy it
Icerind weapon (+20% vs Cold)
Blight weapon (+20% vs Weakened or Vulnerable): Chilling Winds applies both
Blizzard scroll (+20% Ice for the team) and Ice Shards (3-cost Ice dump) keep the stacks going
Cast Amplify from a Corvolus ally (Ice is in its list)
Element Mastery capstone (Ice included)
Frostburned Rune, Snorb (extra Cold)
Anti-synergy: any non-Ice filler move strips a stack, so mixed-element kits and Wicked Crown (Physical to Dark) kill the ramp
items.partyValue: Frost Stacks is self-only. Chilling Winds puts Vulnerable and Weakened on every enemy before its hit, which raises party damage through statuses (unpriced), and Blizzard paired with it is a team Ice buff.

items.name: Lentum (Ob)
items.note: Slime Regen: a flat 2 HP of passive regeneration each turn, always on. Small, and scaled by incoming healing like other flat self-heals.
synergies: Incoming-healing sources (Frugality-style incHealPct, Raging Warrior armour's inc-heal) scale the flat regen
Blight weapon (+20% vs Weakened or Vulnerable): Slimy Shield applies Weakened on block
Poison consumers for Bane: Metrom's Grasp (+40% DoT), Shattering shards (per target debuff), Assassin/Ranger poison kits
Anti-synergy: Slimy Buckler says it does NOT stack with Slimy Shield, so do not pair them
Gelat Band (cosmetic only)
items.partyValue: Slime Regen is self-only. Mucilage can target an ally for 3 turns of DR, a real party defence, but its percentage is unstated so it is not priced.

items.name: Amorus (Ob)
items.note: Holy/Nature Weakness is a COST: Holy- and Nature-affinity attacks deal 15% more damage to you. Stated, but only on those elements, so it is not scored until an incoming-element kind exists. The stun and Hex immunities are real, with no number.
synergies: Rabbit's Foot: immune to the Hex half of its self-debuff roll (Cursed still lands)
Lights Out scroll: its backfire Stun cannot land on you
Arbiter (N) (3 Hex attacks) and Madseer's Codex (statuses on Hex attacks) for a Hex kit with Undulating Hex

Reversing shards (per debuff on self) plus Sinister Gaze sharing those debuffs to feed Shattering (per debuff on target): a speculative self-debuff niche, since whether sharing removes them from you is unstated
Anti-synergy: Thorian, The Rotten is immune to Hex (Hex becomes Vulnerable); Holy- or Nature-heavy bosses (Seraphon summons a Saint) hit Amorus 15% harder
Cast Amplify does not cover Hex, so a Corvolus ally does not buff Amorus's race attacks
items.partyValue: Nothing reaches allies. Sinister Gaze only moves buffs to you and debuffs to the enemy.

items.name: Sheea (Ob)
items.note: Every cooldown is 1 turn shorter (now stated in the passive text). This stacks with the STR 110 and ARC 110 milestone cuts. It matters most on moves you repeat, and short cooldowns gain the most in proportion.
synergies: STR 110 / ARC 110 milestone cooldown cuts (they add together)
Saint (Or) and other healers that repeat a heal
Short-cooldown setups: Shadow Form 7 to 6, Brittle Cure-style buffs (once the setup uptime reads the cut)
Holy kits (Skyward Bolt is Holy): Paladin, Saint, Runic Shield users
items.partyValue: Reduced Cooldowns only helps you. His Incandescence can cleanse and buff an ally's highest stat plus heal them a little, but no amount is stated, so it is listed as party utility and not scored.

items.name: Inferion (Ob)

effects.name: Burning Fury
effects.note: About +15% damage while YOU are Burning, Ghostflame or Inferno. It does not stack. The only way the kit burns you is Inferno Rift, so it is priced through the Inferno Rift setup below. Do NOT also add it as a passive dmgPct, or it counts twice. The passive path (passiveTotals) ignores needsStatus, and the gear path only checks ENEMY statuses.

effects.name: Demonic Presence
effects.note: +5% damage and +5% DR every 5 turns, up to 5 stacks. It is worth nothing on an opener and has 1 stack at turn 5. Over an assumed 10-turn fight that averages about +3.5% damage and 3.5% DR, and over the 6-turn SUSTAIN horizon about +1.7%. statRamp only handles stats, so this needs a percent-ramp kind. The +1 regen part is bugged in game.

effects.name: Demonic Presence regen
effects.note: The text says the extra regen buff is bugged right now.

effects.name: Magic Frailty
effects.note: COST: you take 25% more Magic damage, and 10% less Poison damage. It is not scored because the model has no incoming damage element. Against Arcane or Magic bosses this is a real survival loss.

effects.name: 2 Lives
effects.note: COST: 2 lives instead of the usual 3. Lives are not scored.

effects.name: Demonic Rage
effects.note: Revive at 50% max HP, once every 5 fights. It is a toolbar skill used after you fall, and it ONLY works in a party or in a boss fight with more than 1 life. Not scored: it is a second life, not a per-turn number.

items.note: Burning Fury (about +15% while you burn) is only reliably on when Inferno Rift has burned you, so it is priced as an Inferno Rift setup: 3 energy, cd 9, 3 turns. Demonic Presence ramps from zero. Magic Frailty and 2 Lives are costs.
synergies: Torching Soul scroll (Warrior/Martial Artist): heals 3% max HP each time you are inflicted with Burn, which offsets Rift's self-burn
Impaler (Ch) / Berserker (Ch) low-HP stance: the self-burn pushes you down toward Bloody Berserker / Bloodlust range
Dragon weapon (+15% vs Burning) and Blaze / Lightning Crash / Blazing Barrage Proficiency: Rift puts 3 Burn on the target
Cursed enchant (+20% vs Sundered) and Shattering shards: Rift puts 2 Sunder on the target
Inferno enchant (+20% while Burn is applied): Rift makes sure a Burn is up
items.partyValue: No effect reaches allies. Inferno Rift also hits enemies next to the target (AoE damage, not a buff). Demonic Rage only works in a party or a multi-life boss fight, so it is a party-play feature but helps only you.

items.name: Gynx (Ob)

effects.name: Meditative Energy
effects.note: Meditate gives 2 energy instead of 1, so +1 energy per Meditate turn (stated). The energy ledger has no Meditate turn yet, so it is a note until it does.

effects.name: Primordial Roar
effects.note: Cost 0, cd 10. The -25% enemy damage for 3 turns is marked '(currently bugged)', so it is not priced. The other half stops statuses on you (except stuns) from decaying for 3 turns, then gives ShieldHP equal to 2 x the number of negative status stacks on you. That depends on what the enemy puts on you, so it is a note.

effects.name: Energy Mantle
effects.note: On a Meditate turn, the damage you take (TrueDMG before your defence, dodged hits included) becomes ShieldHP at the start of your next turn, capped at your END. Not priced: the size depends on incoming damage, which the model does not assume. The cap grows with END.

effects.name: Hand of the Colossus
effects.note: Race attack (level 40, cost 2, cd 8, 10 damage). The scaling is 'STR/? + END/?', which is not stated, and race attacks are left out of the scored kit. It hits all enemies with 3 turns of Weakened and 2 of Taunt. The Weakened is a real enemy status for status readers; check that buildDoes/statusesOf picks it up from race moves before adding a separate status entry.

items.note: Nothing in Gynx has a number the engine can use today. Meditate gives +1 extra energy (needs a Meditate-aware energy kind), Energy Mantle turns damage taken while meditating into a shield capped at END, Primordial Roar's damage cut is bugged, and Hand of the Colossus has unstated scaling.
synergies: Focused Mind (+20% for a turn after Meditate, 15% more damage taken): Gynx makes that Meditate +2 energy, and Energy Mantle's shield covers the extra damage taken
Berserker (Ch) Carnage (+20% per energy spent past the first): 2-energy Meditates refill the pool faster
Blasphemy/Heresy wing swap that costs a Meditate turn: Gynx turns that turn into +2 energy
Church of Raphion Spreading Grace (ally +1 energy on your Meditate, a heal burst when hit mid-meditation): the same meditate-and-get-hit loop as Energy Mantle
Weakened readers for Hand of the Colossus: Crushing Strike Proficiency, Carnage Proficiency, Blight weapon (+20% vs Weakened/Vulnerable)
Primordial Roar status freeze: keeps self statuses up for Impaler's Deranged Fighter (+1% incoming healing per unique status) and self-stack shard counts
END-stacking tanks (base END 8): Energy Mantle's cap and Hand of the Colossus both scale with END
items.partyValue: Nothing buffs allies directly. Hand of the Colossus Taunts every enemy hit for 2 turns, pulling attacks off your team (real tank value, not priced). Primordial Roar's -25% enemy damage would protect the whole party, but it is bugged.

items.name: Arborivia (3%)

effects.name: Vine Guard
effects.note: +2.5% DR per landed attack (once a turn), up to 5 stacks = 12.5%. It starts at zero and resets after any turn you do not attack, including setup and Meditate turns. Uptime 0.6 is an assumed average of about 3 stacks.

effects.name: Vine Guard regen
effects.note: +0.75 flat regen per stack, up to 3.75 a turn. The text says it scales with OUTGOING healing, but the engine multiplies selfHealFlat by incoming healing (optimize.js:1047), so it needs a scaling flag.

effects.name: Overgrowth crit
effects.note: Unchanged. +10 crit when you cast at max HP. It applies at cast, so it covers the move being cast.

effects.name: Overgrowth DR
effects.note: +10% DR from cast until the start of your next turn, so it covers the enemy's turn. Stated in the same line as the crit.

effects.name: Overgrowth Speed

Rage Empower Proficiency's Death Defy (survive the fatal hit you are courting)
Carnage (the energy gain feeds its +20% per energy)
Rage Empower (35% HP, one hit from the gate)
Estella Hyper Rage, Molten Carapace (other low-HP payoffs)

items.name: Rage Empower Proficiency

synergies: Intense Rage / Bloodlust (Death Defy is the safety net for a sub-30% stance)
Berserkin Time DR
Survival/tank goals rather than damage goals

items.name: Energy Manipulator
items.note: +3.75% damage per energy held, 22.5% at 6, read after the move's cost. Blaze (cost 1) from a full pool gets 18.75%. Lightning Crash dumps everything and gets 0.
synergies: Blaze (cost 1: the move that keeps the pool high)
Elemental Defense / Gale Uplift Proficiency / Caster / ARC energy chance (refill the pool)
ANTI: Lightning Crash consumes all energy, so zero on the kit's nuke
Corealloy weapon series reads energy after cost too, but Elementalist is Staff-only

items.name: Blaze Proficiency

effects.note: Burning guaranteed 6T, Vulnerable 3T, to all enemies

effects.moveProxy: Blaze is the kit's only Fire move

effects.note: the second 15 vs a burning target: 0 on the first Blaze, near-permanent after (6T burn, cd 5)

items.note: On Blaze alone: +15% always, +30% against a burning target. It now guarantees 6 turns of Burning, adds 3 turns of Vulnerable, and hits all enemies. The site applies it inline to Blaze (builder.js:4845); the engine does not.
synergies: Lightning Crash Proficiency (+20% vs Burning, met permanently once Blaze lands)
Dragon weapon series +15% vs Burning (but Elementalist is Staff-only)
Monk allies: Blazing Barrage Proficiency and Heated Recovery vs burning
Energy Manipulator (Blaze costs 1, keeps energy high)
Element Mastery + Elemental Master both cover Fire
items.partyValue: Vulnerable (3T) on every enemy raises the whole party's damage, and a guaranteed 6T Burning turns on allies' vs-Burning bonuses.

items.name: Elemental Defense
items.note: 50% chance of +1 energy when hit by a Holy, Fire, Magic or Nature attack, and it can proc more than once per attack. Its value depends on the enemy's elements. Not scored: the engine has no energy-gain kind.
synergies: Energy Manipulator (more held energy = more damage)
Lightning Crash (+12.5% per energy past 3)
Elemental Master passive (25% less damage from the same elements: a tank line vs caster bosses)
Fire/Magic bosses such as Yar'thul (Blaze Eruption, Armageddon are Fire)

items.name: Lightning Crash Proficiency

effects.moveProxy: Lightning Crash is the kit's only Magic move
effects.openerZero: 0 if cast before any Burning is applied

effects.note: guaranteed 1 Stun to every enemy (base: a chance); bosses resist stun

items.note: +20% on Lightning Crash against burning targets, and its Stun becomes guaranteed on every enemy. Pays fully once Blaze has put Burning up.
synergies: Blaze / Blaze Proficiency (guaranteed 6T Burning: the needsStatus is met on every Lightning Crash after a Blaze)
Lancer (N) ally with Overload (+100% vs stunned): a cross-player combo
Overflow / energy gain (Lightning Crash +12.5% per energy past 3)
ANTI: Energy Manipulator reads 0 after this dumps the pool
items.partyValue: A guaranteed AoE stun costs every enemy its turn, which protects the whole party, and lets a Lancer ally's Overload pay double.

items.name: Element Mastery
items.note: +15% to Magic, Fire, Nature, Holy, Dark and Ice attacks, at full value on those elements and nothing on Physical, Poison or Hex.
synergies: Elemental Master passive (+20% Fire/Magic/Nature/Dark, same moves)
Corvolus Cast Amplify (identical element list)
Shard of Blight on Dark moves
Wicked Crown (Physical -> Dark, so even Strike qualifies)
Ice Shards scroll (3-energy Ice dump)

items.name: Gale Uplift Proficiency
items.note: +1 energy per autododge while Gale Uplift is up, at most 2 per round; dodging the QTE does not count. Not scored: needs an energy-gain kind and an autododge rate.
synergies: Gale Uplift's own +32 Speed to allies (SPD 110 milestone gives 5% autododge)
autododge sources: Vastayan/Ophimar Speed races, dodge gear
Energy Manipulator and Lightning Crash (spend the refunded energy)
Elemental Defense (the other refill)

items.name: Strategist
items.note: +5% DR per unique negative status on you, no cap stated. A Hexer's kit puts no status on itself, so the count depends on what enemies (or self-poisoning gear) land. Zero on an opener, when you start clean.
synergies: Inverse Flaws (Hexer 2nd learn: each new status on you heals 2% and gives +5% defence for that hit - same trigger)
Status Master (reads the same self-status count for energy)
Inverse Abyss / Inverse Abyss Proficiency (the debuff that lands on you counts here before it is reflected)
Ptera's Heart (poisons YOU - the only controllable self-status source)
Reversing enchant (also reads your own statuses)

items.name: Abyss Anchor Proficiency
items.note: Abyss Anchor becomes AoE and puts 5 Vulnerable and 4 Weakened on its targets. Vulnerable is 20% more damage taken, per the site's own status table. Tactician already covers the opening turns, so this extends Vulnerable uptime over a fight at the cost of a 2-energy utility turn. The Weakened magnitude is unstated.
synergies: Tactician (Hexer 1st learn: opens with 3 Vulnerable/3 Weakened on all enemies - covers the opener, this covers the rest)
Dark Glare (3 Vulnerable on its own target)
Brawler party member: Oppression (+5% per unique status) and Crushing Strike Proficiency (+20% vs vulnerable or weakened)
Shattering enchant (counts enemy statuses)
ARC 110 milestone (Abyss Anchor is Hex, non-Physical: cd 5 -> 4 makes 5 stacks near-permanent)
items.partyValue: AoE Vulnerable makes every ally's hit on every afflicted enemy deal 20% more for as long as it lasts, so it is a team damage multiplier. Weakened on all enemies cuts incoming damage for the whole party, magnitude unstated.

items.name: Status Master
items.note: 10% energy chance per status on you at turn start. It reads your own status count, which a Hexer's kit does not supply and which is zero on an opener. The engine's energy figure does not gate damage yet, so even priced it moves little.
synergies: Strategist (same self-status count, DR instead of energy)
Inverse Flaws (its +5% defence buff may itself count as a status)
Ptera's Heart (self-poison is a controllable +1)
Inverse Abyss (3 energy - the move this energy funds; its proficiency adds +1 energy per proc)
Reversing enchant (reads the same self statuses)

items.name: Dark Glare Proficiency
items.note: Dark Glare costs 1 energy instead of 2. Damage is unchanged. Hexer opens with a full pool (assumed), so the saving shows only over a sustained fight where Dark Glare (cd 4), Abyss Anchor (2) and Inverse Abyss (3) compete for energy.
synergies: Shard of Blight (+25% to Dark moves - Dark Glare is Dark)
Corvolus Cast Amplify (Dark-gated)
ARC 110 milestone (non-Physical cd 4 -> 3, so the cheaper cast comes round more often)
Oppression / Shattering (Dark Glare applies 4 unique statuses: Vulnerable, Blinded, Weakened, Hex)
Hexed (its 1 Hex doubles the next incoming hit, per builder.js:6431)

items.name: Delayed Hex
items.note: When an ally or your own summon dies, its killer gets 2 Hexed, so the next two hits on it deal double. A Hexer has no summons, so solo it never triggers. In a party it depends on a teammate dying, which a build should not plan for, and the count is unstated.
synergies: Darkwraith party member: Dark Smite Proficiency (extra orb against a hexed enemy)
Necromancer party member: Raise Dead / Raise Death Proficiency (the ally who died comes back to hit the hexed killer)
Dark Glare (its own 1 Hex stacks on the same target)
items.partyValue: Two Hexed on the enemy that killed an ally means the team's next two hits on it deal double. Real punishment for a wipe-in-progress, but gated on losing an ally.

items.name: Inverse Abyss Proficiency
items.note: Each Inverse Abyss proc gives you +1 energy and puts 3 random statuses at 3 stacks on the debuffer. Procs depend on how often enemies debuff your team and are capped at ARC/65 per cast. The statuses are random, so no status gate can rely on them.
synergies: Arcane investment (ARC/65 activations per cast)
Strategist and Status Master (the debuff that triggers a proc lands on you first and feeds both)
Inverse Flaws (heal and defence on the same incoming debuff)
Brawler party member: Oppression (random statuses raise the enemy's unique-status count)
Shattering enchant (enemy status count)
items.partyValue: The field covers the whole team, so any ally being debuffed can proc it: +1 energy to you and 3x3 random debuffs onto the enemy, which feeds allies' status-count damage. Value scales with how debuff-heavy the encounter is.

items.name: Death Edge
items.note: -1 cooldown on Darklight Drain each time anything on the field dies. How many deaths a fight has is unstated, and masteries have no cooldown-cut column. Free skeletons (Call Skeleton Proficiency) and multi-mob encounters are what feed it.
synergies: Call Skeleton Proficiency (0-energy skeletons are disposable death fuel)
Final Goodbye (the same summon deaths stack Arcane)
Death Siphon (Necromancer 1st learn: heal on ally/summon death)
Darklight Drain Proficiency (every extra cast refreshes the summon buff and the party regen)
ARC 110 milestone (Darklight Drain is Dark: cd 5 -> 4 before any deaths)

items.name: Call Skeleton Proficiency
items.note: Call Skeleton costs 0 energy. After a skeleton dies, your next skeleton gets +30% damage, +50% HP, 20% DR and 2% regen. It is summon power, not your damage, and the opening skeleton never has it.
synergies: Vastayan Spirit Caller (Skeletons +50% HP - stacks with this +50%)
Darklight Drain (+5% summon damage per use to 10%) and Darklight Drain Proficiency (+15% summon damage/DR)
Final Goodbye, Death Edge and Death Siphon (a skeleton dying is what all three trigger on)
Imbuement Reliquary (summons gain your enchant)
Anti-synergy: Life Absorption wants slots kept full, and this wants skeletons to die

items.name: Life Absorption

extra.newKind: regenPerSummon (healPctPerTurn for masteries, scaled by own summon count)

items.note: 2.5% regen per summon slot you fill, 10% at 4. The text does not say whether regen means % of max HP per turn, and the engine has no regen loop. It is zero on an opener and slow to fill at one skeleton per 5 turns.
synergies: Call Skeleton / Call Skeleton Proficiency (0-cost skeletons fill slots)
Necromancer innate 4-summon cap
Vastayan Spirit Caller (sturdier skeletons stay alive, so slots stay full)
Anti-synergy: Final Goodbye, Death Edge and Call Skeleton Proficiency's black skeleton all want summons to die, which empties slots

items.name: Darklight Drain Proficiency

effects.what: 20% passive regen buff to everyone for 3 turns - regen unmodelled

items.note: Each Darklight Drain gives all summons +15% damage and +15% DR for 4 turns, and everyone a 20% passive-regen buff for 3 turns. Cast on its 5-turn cooldown that is 80% uptime, and full uptime once ARC 110 cuts the cooldown to 4. It is zero until the first cast.
synergies: ARC 110 milestone (Darklight Drain is Dark: cd 5 -> 4 = 4-turn buff permanently up)
Death Edge (deaths cut the cd further)
Darklight Drain's own +5%/use summon damage (to 10%)
Call Skeleton Proficiency (black skeleton +30% on top)
Blessing of Life (builder.js:3845, doubles passive regen in fights) for the party regen half
Shard of Blight / Corvolus Cast Amplify (Darklight Drain is a Dark attack, which is what triggers the buff)
items.partyValue: The 20% passive regen reaches every ally for 3 turns per cast, a team sustain effect. 'All summons' may include allies' summons too; the text does not restrict it to yours.

items.name: Final Goodbye

extra.newKind: statPctRamp (percent stat per event stack; statRamp is flat and gear-only)

items.note: Each summon death gives an Arcane buff stack, 5% each up to 15%. It is zero on an opener. Duration, how fast deaths come, and whether 'Arcane buff' means the stat or damage are all unstated.
synergies: Call Skeleton Proficiency (free skeletons to spend - and the next one comes back black)
Death Edge and Death Siphon (same deaths: Darklight Drain cd and a heal)
Darklight Drain (ARC/75) and skeleton moves (ARC/50, HP ARC/4) are all Arcane-scaled
Anti-synergy: Life Absorption (full slots)

items.name: Raise Death Proficiency
items.note: Raise Dead revives at 80% HP instead of 60%, the ally cannot die until their next turn, and the cooldown drops from 16 to 11. The revived ally still loses their turn. The engine has no revive, and solo it does nothing.
synergies: Death Siphon (the ally's death already healed you)
Hexer party member: Delayed Hex (the killer is hexed, and the revived ally hits it for double)
ARC 110 milestone (Raise Dead is Dark: cd 11 -> 10)
Death Edge (an ally death also cuts Darklight Drain)
items.partyValue: A faster, safer revive: back at 80% HP and unkillable through the enemy's next round, every 11 turns instead of 16. Large in a party that is losing members, worth nothing to your own sheet.

Verdant Archer
Arborivia (3%) Leaf Thrust
Dust Storm

Crystal Sphere
Enrichment

Perennial Canopy
Stinger
Enrichment Proficiency
Verdant Archer
Stultus (20%) Focus Step

synergies: Nature's Wrath
Verdant Archer
Dust Storm
Arborivia (3%) Leaf Thrust
Stellian Core
Crystalized Star

Sandstone

Impure Crown

Verdant Archer
Nature's Wrath
Perennial Canopy

synergies: Flourish Proficiency
Verdant Archer
Lightspeed
Enrichment Proficiency
Flourish

Poison Trap Proficiency
Looter
Impure Crown

Trapper
Slash Barrage
Vital Strike
Oppression

Blader
Tear Blood Crystal

Slash Barrage Proficiency

Vital Strike

Trapper

synergies: Poison Fan Proficiency

Shadow Master

Shattering / Reversing shards (count enemy statuses)

synergies: Shadow (passive)
Risk Taker
Stealth Strike Proficiency
Lightspeed-style autododge gear

Poisoner (5 Poison per crit)

Arborivia / Luck crit

High-HP / Endurance pools that spend long in the low band

items.name: Holy Protection

Endurance / DR stacking

items.note: +20% to Blazing Barrage only, and 2 Blinded, when the target is already burning. The kit applies Burn (25% per hit on Barrage itself), but not before the first cast, so nothing on the opener and most casts after.

Heated Recovery

Fire Sutra / Fire Sutra Proficiency
Blazing Barrage Proficiency

Corvolus Cast Amplify (+20% fire)
Flaming Overdrive (meditate buff on the next superclass move)
ARC 110 (non-Physical cooldown cut)

Fire Sutra (also ally-targetable: a support Monk)
Incoming-heal effects on the target
Debuff-heavy bosses (BOSS_TACTICS)

Flaming Overdrive (+1% per burning stack)
Ally fire/burn kits

Oppression
Crusher
Cursed
Sandstone

Hiemal

Oppression
